jobs.jobDescription:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager – Heart Health to join our growing Health Sensing organization. Reporting to the Director of Product Management, Health Risk Detection, this role will focus on advancing Oura’s cardiovascular health experiences, from proactive monitoring to long-term heart health insights.

You’ll join an established, cross-functional team dedicated to Heart Health. You’ll collaborate with Science, Design, Engineering, and Regulatory partners to accelerate our roadmap, deepen member value, and bring science-backed heart health features to life. This is a high-impact opportunity to help shape how millions of people understand and care for their cardiovascular health through wearable technology.

This remote role is open to candidates residing in the Eastern Time Zone and requires periodic travel to Boston, MA.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner closely with Science and Engineering teams to define and deliver next-generation heart health sensing and signal analysis capabilities
  • Translate scientific findings and physiological concepts into intuitive, meaningful product experiences that empower members to better understand their heart health
  • Support discovery and development of new features spanning both wellness and regulated use cases
  • Contribute to the prioritization and delivery of roadmap initiatives, balancing scientific feasibility, user impact, and business opportunity
  • Partner with Design to create user experiences that communicate complex heart health data with simplicity and empathy
  • Collaborate with Regulatory, Legal, and Quality teams on product strategies that align with applicable regulatory frameworks
  • Communicate progress, insights, and tradeoffs effectively to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Contribute to the broader Health Risk Detection strategy and align heart health workstreams with Oura’s mission to empower proactive health ownership

REQUIREMENTS

We would love to have you on our team if you have:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in connected health, digital biomarkers, or wearable sensing.
  • Experience delivering products or research-based features in cardiovascular health, fitness, or related physiological domains.
  • Strong understanding of key cardiovascular signals (e.g., HRV, ECG, PPG, blood pressure estimation) and their application in consumer or regulated products.
  • Proven success translating early-stage scientific research into member-facing experiences.
  • Familiarity with the nuances between wellness and medical-grade products; experience with FDA or other regulatory processes is a plus.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills with scientists, engineers, designers, and clinicians.
  • A passion for helping people live longer, healthier lives through actionable, science-backed insights.

BENEFITS

At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave

jobs.jobDescription:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Enterprise AI builds and operates the internal AI platform layer that supports Spotifiers across the company. We’re helping evolve AI tooling into reliable infrastructure that teams can use in their day-to-day work. Our team builds the connective tissue between AI models and Spotify’s internal systems, with a focus on secure access, governance, identity, integrations, and dependable AI infrastructure.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and operate secure enterprise AI platform capabilities that connect AI models, agents, tools, and Spotify’s internal systems.
  • Own major workstreams across our enterprise AI infrastructure, including our Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway and enterprise context capabilities, from technical design through launch and operation.
  • Build reliable backend services, APIs, and integrations that enable AI-powered experiences across Spotify’s digital workplace.
  • Help develop scalable approaches to AI governance, including identity-aware access, permissions, auditing, policy enforcement, and managing risks associated with third-party AI-enabled tools.
  • Design, build, test, and evaluate agentic systems and workflows that help Spotifiers access information and accomplish tasks effectively.
  • Take operational ownership of the services and components you build, balancing speed, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.
  • Partner with engineers and stakeholders across Spotify to identify opportunities, make thoughtful technical tradeoffs, and turn emerging AI needs into scalable platform capabilities.
  • Contribute to engineering practices, knowledge sharing, and AI fluency as we learn how to operate enterprise AI infrastructure at Spotify scale.

Who You Are

  • You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building, testing, debugging, and operating reliable backend systems.
  • You are experienced with backend languages such as Python, Go, or similar and are comfortable designing APIs and integrations across complex systems.
  • You understand software architecture and how services, APIs, enterprise tools, and user-facing experiences fit together.
  • You have experience with identity and authentication concepts and technologies such as OAuth, SAML, or SCIM.
  • You have experience working with cloud infrastructure; familiarity with Google Cloud Platform is valuable.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, creating clarity, and independently making thoughtful technical tradeoffs.
  • You care about operational ownership and building dependable infrastructure that other teams and employees can rely on.
  • You enjoy experimentation, iteration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning in a collaborative engineering environment.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS or platform engineering, or with LLM integration patterns such as tool use, function calling, agentic workflows, or systems-level prompt engineering, will help you make an impact in this role.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in New York.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Compensation

Additional Information

The United States base range for this position is $164,448–$234,926 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

jobs.jobDescription:
Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

This is a remote position, preferably based in the DMV area (Washington DC, Maryland, Virginia) or located in the Eastern Time Zone as it will require regular in person meetings in those regions.

Tines is looking for a Senior Partner Solutions Engineer to join our pre-sales team, who are crucial to our growth and winning customers. You will work with our Channel Partner team to evangelize Tines' SaaS solutions and educate existing and potential Partners on the business value that their customers can gain with intelligent workflows. You will use your product and technical knowledge to build enablement programs for our partners so that they can articulate the value of Tines and its approach to automation and integration. You will understand customers’ business pains and the outcomes they want to achieve and will guide the partners to show how Tines can help their customers realize those outcomes.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop strong and deep knowledge of Tines automation and apply your knowledge to security & IT challenges that our customers face
  • Create and deliver compelling presentations to key alliance partners as you clearly communicate the value and differentiation of Tines solutions
  • Build and demo Tines with partners to show value and win sales with their customers
  • Collaborate with Sales to identify key use cases where partners can or have developed solutions using the Tines platform
  • Create and execute enablement of Tines’ priority channel and technical alliance partners and support their pre-sales engineers on customer engagements
  • Be a key source of market feedback into the product organization
  • Contribute to our knowledge base by sharing key customer experiences & technical competitive insights and creating new Tines automation stories from customer and partner interactions and more
  • Support the greater Solutions Engineering team in developing metrics and refining SE operations into best practices that are shared across all SE teams

Responsibilities you will assume:

  • Provide strategic thought leadership by driving the strategic direction for Solutions Engineering within North America, aligning with overall business goals and specifically with the strategy around Partnerships
  • Mentor and provide guidance to other Solutions Engineers, fostering professional growth and skill development within the team
  • Represent Tines at industry events, conferences, and webinars, showcasing the value of our solutions and establishing Tines as a thought leader in automation
  • Work closely with product management, marketing, and engineering teams to influence product roadmap and strategy based on market and customer insights
  • Act as a senior advocate for key partners, ensuring their needs are met and their feedback is incorporated into product development
  • Identify and drive initiatives that enhance the overall effectiveness and efficiency of the sales engineering function, including process improvements and new tool adoption

What you bring with you:

  • 7+ years of experience in a pre-sales / sales engineering or technology delivery at a SaaS company with emphasis on partner engagement
  • Strong technical background and experience working with APIs and a curiosity to learn new cloud technologies
  • Working knowledge of AI-Assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, etc.)
  • Security and/or IT industry experience
  • Public Sector industry experience
  • Strong skills and experience with uncovering customer needs
  • Experience with delivering compelling demos to customers and winning technical evaluations
  • Experience communicating with business and technical audiences to establish trust and influence key decision makers
  • A love for learning, openness to giving and receiving feedback, and a passion for making clients successful
  • Project management skills and ability to deliver customer solutions
  • Ability to craft actionable insights from complex data
  • A startup mentality with the ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to travel up to 30% of the time

Target Annual Compensation (salary + commission): $225-245k OTE

Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

Tines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic features, language, religion or belief, political or any other opinion, membership of a national minority, property, birth, disability, age or sexual orientation.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

The Regional Marketing Associate supports the execution of regional marketing plans across AMER, working with all Regional Marketing Managers to deliver programs based on team priorities.

You will own assigned programs and tasks from setup through post-event reporting, using established playbooks, processes, and templates. Your manager will set priorities in partnership with the Regional Marketing Managers. You will be responsible for delivering accurate, high-quality work on time, asking for guidance when needed, and flagging risks early.

You will use AI and data tools daily to improve efficiency and inform your work, while remaining accountable for the accuracy and quality of everything you deliver.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Execute programs across AMER. Support all Regional Marketing Managers by delivering assigned events, campaigns and ABM activities using established playbooks, from setup through follow-up. Your manager will set priorities in partnership with the Regional Marketing Managers.
  • Manage program operations. Build registration pages, emails, landing pages and campaign workflows in the team’s tools. Coordinate paid social execution, vendors and logistics as assigned.
  • Ensure quality before launch. Review event setup, assets, emails and landing pages for accuracy, completeness and functionality before they go live.
  • Report on results. Maintain accurate program data, track agreed metrics and prepare post-event and campaign reports using standard tools and templates.
  • Keep the team informed. Maintain timelines and task status in Monday.com, and proactively communicate progress and changes.
  • Support budget operations. Track program expenses, manage purchase orders and coordinate invoices with Finance.
  • Use AI and improve processes. Apply AI and data tools daily to work more efficiently, validate outputs and share useful workflows and process improvements with the team.
  • Flag issues early. Bring risks, blockers, unclear requirements and competing requests to your manager early so priorities and next steps can be resolved.

What you'll bring at this level:

  • Located in EST or CST
  • 2+ years in field marketing, regional marketing or events
  • Strong organization and close attention to detail
  • Experience with, or fast ramp on, Splash, Zuddl, Salesforce and Monday.com
  • Comfort using AI and the judgment to validate its output
  • Clear written communication
  • Willingness to travel approximately 40%

Compensation & Rewards:

In the US, the Compensation range for this role is $88,000 - $92,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

  • Drive the design and unification of workflows and tooling that support reliable training, orchestration, and deployment of ML systems.
  • Partner with data scientists and engineers to improve the end-to-end ML lifecycle, from experimentation and training through deployment and governance, while making production ML systems easier to manage and maintain.

  • Partner with data engineering and platform teams to align ML systems with broader data platform and governance practices.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfort operating in a distributed team with a high degree of ownership and autonomy.

What makes you stand out

  • Experience supporting multiple data science teams through shared MLOps platforms or tooling.
  • Prior experience with Databricks.
  • Experience with governance and operational controls for ML systems at scale.
  • Experience driving cross-team tooling or workflow standardization in ML or data platforms.

jobs.jobDescription:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Labs is looking for a technically fluent engineer who loves building powerful demos, explaining complex systems clearly, and helping SRE and platform engineering leaders understand the value of our open approach to observability.

As Grafana’s offering shifts from dashboards to industry-leading agentic observability, our Product Marketing team is responsible for closing the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. That means building clear, consistent positioning, enabling sellers with trustworthy technical narratives, and creating content that helps Platform Engineering teams quickly grasp why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.

As a Technical Product Marketer you will play a critical part in that transformation. You’ll be the hands-on engineer who brings our technical story to life for buyers, not just practitioners. You’ll build core demos, run technical workshops and webinars, and act as the technical bridge between our Product and Sales orgs. Your work will help SRE and platform engineering leaders evaluate Grafana with confidence, equip sales engineers with better tools and talk tracks, and ensure our technical value shows up clearly and consistently across the entire customer journey.

This is a unique chance to shape how Grafana tells its story as we evolve our positioning in the AI era, strengthen seller enablement, and build a repeatable system for communicating product value.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build strategic, buyer-focused demos, videos, workshops, and webinars

  • Create and maintain polished, narrative-driven demos that highlight Grafana’s value for SRE and platform engineering leaders.
  • Record high-quality technical demo videos and walkthroughs in partnership with our video and content teams.
  • Lead webinars, workshops, and technical sessions designed for evaluators.
  • Teach customers not just how Grafana works, but why our approach is differentiated and valuable.
  • Use AI tools to generate variations, summaries, and reusable assets that scale technical content across channels.

Enable Solutions (Sales) Engineers with clear, consistent technical storytelling

  • Serve as PMM’s technical liaison to the SE org, ensuring consistent messaging and demo guidance.
  • Produce technical enablement assets, value-driven talk tracks, competitive narratives, and demo best practices.
  • Help SEs and sellers communicate Grafana’s story with clarity, confidence, and differentiation.

Collaborate with PMMs to drive technical buyer engagement across high-impact channels

  • Partner with PMMs to identify the most important buyer personas, problems, and technical messages, and help shape the content strategy needed to reach them.
  • Extend technical narratives into impactful buyer-facing channels including analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester), industry forums, podcasts, conferences, and online technical communities.
  • Bring a technical perspective to PMM planning—helping ensure our content, campaigns, and enablement reflect the real challenges and priorities of SREs and engineering leaders.

Use automation & AI to scale technical content

  • Partner with software engineers to streamline demo setup, content workflows, and asset updates through workflows, agents, scripts, and AI-driven tools.
  • Use automation to make technical content more repeatable, discoverable, and scalable across teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 5+ years in a technical role (solutions engineering, SRE, DevOps, backend engineering, technical PMM, or similar).
  • Interest and ability to travel to training and customer events 10-12 weeks per year.
  • Strong understanding of observability concepts and the needs of SRE/platform teams.
  • Ability to translate deep technical concepts into clear, value-focused stories.
  • Experience presenting technical content through demos, workshops, or webinars.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a crisp, structured, persuasive style.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration; comfort working with PMM, Product, SEs, DevRel, and Field Engineering.
  • High ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects from concept to completion.
  • Comfort with light scripting or workflow automation.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, or similar observability tools, or a background in Observability or Platform Engineering.
  • Prior experience in Sales Engineering, DevRel, or technical product marketing.
  • Familiarity with demo environment automation or infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Exceptional live presentation or workshop facilitation skills.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the US, the base compensation range for this role is $183,858 - $220,630. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

You will lead complex projects, mentor junior team members, and contribute significantly to the strategic direction of our technology..

This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based in San Francisco, San Diego, or Boston.

The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Growlithe is a fast-moving squad within Spotify's Conversation Product Area, focused on bringing emerging Search and agentic experiences to life. We explore, define, build, validate, and optimize new ideas to help listeners discover the content they love. Our work spans personalized Search, music video discovery and ranking, audiobook Search expansion, and the foundations of more social Search experiences.

We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to help shape the next generation of Search at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of machine learning, personalization, and product development, turning complex challenges into intuitive discovery experiences for millions of listeners.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve machine learning models that make Spotify Search more relevant, personalized, and engaging for listeners.
  • Develop and optimize ranking and backend retrieval systems that help listeners discover music, videos, audiobooks, and other content.
  • Explore emerging AI and agentic approaches to create more intuitive and conversational Search experiences.
  • Design, implement, and evaluate machine learning solutions, taking ideas from early experimentation through production.
  • Partner with engineers, product managers, designers, and researchers to identify opportunities and deliver meaningful improvements to Search.
  • Use experimentation, data analysis, and performance metrics to understand model behavior, validate hypotheses, and improve the listener experience.
  • Contribute to scalable machine learning infrastructure and engineering practices that support reliable, high-quality Search experiences.
  • Share knowledge, challenge assumptions constructively, and help shape the technical direction of machine learning within the squad.

Who You Are

  • You have experience building, deploying, and improving machine learning systems in production environments.
  • You have a strong understanding of machine learning approaches for information retrieval, search ranking, recommendation systems, or personalization.
  • You are proficient in Python and comfortable working with modern machine learning frameworks and data processing tools.
  • You have experience and a desire to lean into backend engineering at Spotify scale.
  • You understand how to design and evaluate experiments, interpret model performance, and translate technical findings into product improvements.
  • You have experience working with large-scale datasets and understand the challenges of building reliable, scalable machine learning systems.
  • You are curious about emerging AI technologies, including large language models and agentic systems, and interested in their potential to improve discovery experiences.
  • You enjoy working across disciplines, communicating technical ideas clearly, and learning from different perspectives.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of complex challenges, and balancing experimentation with practical delivery.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in Eastern Standard Time
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Compensation

Additional Information

The United States base range for this position is 184,049–262,928 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. As a key member of our Customer Success organization, the Senior Manager, Professional Services Engineering is an empathetic, operationally rigorous and forward-thinking leader and mentor, specializing in resource and capacity planning,

You will lead our growing team of engineers across the US and Ireland. As part of our 3-function Professional Services organization (spanning Engagement Management, Project Management, and PSE), you will serve as the champion, coach, and strategic anchor for a team delivering automation solutions to our largest enterprise customers.

This is a high-impact leadership role built for someone who excels at both people-first leadership and operational systems thinking. You will step into a tightly knit, high-performing team that deeply values trust, advocacy, and hands-on career development. Simultaneously, you will bring long-range predictability to our services engine: solving the operational puzzle of dynamic, day-to-day resourcing while architecting capacity models that accurately forecast bench availability and skill distribution 6+ months into the future.

If you are a proactive problem solver who naturally takes complete ownership of initiatives, anticipates operational friction, and elevates the people around you, this role is for you.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Champion & Coach a High-Performing Team: Lead, mentor, and advocate for 8–10+ Professional Services Engineers across the US and Ireland through meaningful 1:1s, tailored career pathing, performance reviews, and active technical/professional coaching.
  • Build Trust & Psychological Safety: Step in as a supportive, empathetic people leader, establishing deep trust with a team navigating leadership transitions and diverse working styles.
  • Master Dynamic Resourcing ("Puzzle-Piece Scheduling"): Own tactile day-to-day engagement allocations, rebalancing resources, priorities, and schedules in real time as deals accelerate, stall, or evolve.
  • Architect 6+ Month Capacity Forecasting: Design, implement, and maintain predictive capacity models to accurately forecast bench availability, hiring triggers, and skillset distribution at least two quarters ahead.
  • Drive Strategic Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner seamlessly with Project Management leadership and Engagement Managers to ensure rock-solid engagement delivery, while collaborating closely with Sales, Customer Experience (CX), and GTM leadership.
  • Influence Product & Engineering: Serve as a conduit between customer delivery and product development; ensure PSEs test early-stage features, provide actionable feedback, and champion the voice of the customer internally.
  • Proactively Own Initiatives: Identify delivery bottlenecks, operational blind spots, and tooling gaps; formulate viable, data-backed solutions and drive their implementation autonomously from concept to completion.
  • Partner with Services Ecosystems: Participate in and co-lead monthly syncs with external services partners to support enablement and scale delivery bandwidth.
  • Drive Operational & Delivery Excellence: Accountable for core delivery metrics including engagement completion rates, CSAT, target billable utilization (70%+), and services expansion opportunities.

What You Bring With You

  • Experience:
    • 10+ years of experience in a post-sales customer facing role at a technology company
    • 5+ years of of direct people leadership or practice experience, with a track record of coaching and developing high-performing technical teams.
  • Demonstrated People-First Leadership: Proven track record directly managing and retaining professional services, solutions engineering, or technical delivery teams in high-growth SaaS environments, with a clear focus on empathy, coaching, and career development.
  • Multi-Horizon Capacity & Resource Planning Expertise: Hands-on experience not just shuffling in-quarter projects, but building and managing rolling 6+ month capacity and utilization forecasts that anticipate bench availability and hiring demand.
  • High Operational Resourcefulness & Ownership: An entrepreneurial mindset that proactively identifies friction, brings structured solutions rather than open-ended problems, and independently drives strategic initiatives to completion.
  • Cross-Functional Relationship Building: Demonstrated ability to build rock-solid trust with PM leadership, Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams to align delivery capacity with commercial pipeline.
  • Technical Fluency in Automation & Modern Tech Stacks: Ability to speak competently on workflow automation, APIs, system integrations, and modern AI/LLM applications to credibly guide engineers and evaluate delivery approaches.
  • Distributed Team Management: Experience coaching and coordinating a remote or geographically distributed engineering team across multiple time zones (US and EMEA).
  • Metric-Driven Delivery Acumen: Solid understanding of professional services metrics, including billable utilization targets (70%+), on-time project completion, CSAT, and services-assisted expansion.

  • Optimize system settings, workflows, and customizations for maximum efficiency.

  • Provide training and support to end-users.

Program Management

  • Manage/Configure finance transformation projects focusing primarily on the order to cash cycle, encompassing Lead/Opportunity, Contract Management, Quoting/CPQ, Order Management, Revenue Recognition, Billing, Credit, Collections/Disputes, and Cash Application processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Legal,Engineering, Finance and IT to gather requirements and implement solutions that enhance business processes.

Dashboard Creation and Reporting

What Makes You a Great Fit:

jobs.jobDescription:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Security engineers at Spotify protect our platform, employees, creators, and more than 700 million users. We are looking for an experienced Security Engineer to join the Detection and Response organization and help identify, investigate, and respond to threats across Spotify's environment.

You will work within our detection engineering squad where the team owns alert triage, security investigations, threat hunting, and the detection engineering lifecycle. You will turn threat intelligence, incident learnings, and analyst feedback into effective detections and investigation workflows. You will partner closely with the detection infrastructure squad, which builds and operates Detection and Response platforms and telemetry pipelines, and with teams across Spotify to make sure your squad has the signals and capabilities needed to detect and respond to threats at Spotify's scale.

We are a distributed team that values curiosity, sound judgment, clear communication, and continuous learning. We teach and learn from one another, adapt as the threat landscape changes, and focus our effort according to business needs and risk.

What You'll Do

  • Identify detection opportunities, define clear telemetry requirements, and partner with the detection infrastructure squad and data owners to make the signals needed for detection and investigation available.

  • Develop, test, tune, and maintain detections across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, email, and other security-relevant environments.

  • Investigate and prioritize alerts, determine their security impact, and participate in incident containment and remediation.

  • Build repeatable investigation workflows and playbooks for alert triage, evidence collection, decision-making, escalation, containment, and response.

  • Improve proactive threat-identification and threat-hunting capabilities using internal telemetry and external threat intelligence.

  • Create cutting-edge AI workflows for Detection and Response that enrich alerts, gather and analyze evidence, guide investigations, and automate repetitive response work while preserving appropriate human judgment and oversight.

  • Measure detection effectiveness, identify coverage gaps, and tune detections to balance security value, fidelity, and analyst workload.

  • Use SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and related security platforms to research threats, develop detections, investigate alerts, and validate security outcomes.

  • Share knowledge, document decisions, and communicate security findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Who You Are

  • You are curious, collaborative, and comfortable making progress in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment.

  • You have 3+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, detection engineering, or closely related work.

  • You understand how analysts triage and investigate alerts and how detection quality affects their decisions and workload.

  • You know how to create and tune detections based on attacker behavior, available telemetry, and an expected investigation path.

  • You are experienced with security platforms such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or comparable monitoring and response technologies.

  • You can write code or use an automation platform to analyze security telemetry, enrich alerts, build investigation workflows, and remove repetitive work. Experience with Python or a similar language is valuable.

  • You understand modern detection-as-code practices, including GitHub, peer review, CI/CD, testing, and safely managing production detection content.

  • You have experience working with at least one major cloud platform, such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure.

  • You understand common threats affecting SaaS-oriented corporate and production environments.

  • You care about clear documentation, inclusive collaboration, and explaining security concepts to people with different backgrounds and levels of expertise.

  • You are excited to create and critically evaluate cutting-edge AI workflows for detection development, alert triage, security investigations, and response, while applying sound security judgment and appropriate human oversight.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in New York

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Compensation

Additional Information

The United States base range for this position is $132,948–$189,927 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

jobs.jobDescription:
Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

We’re looking for a Senior IT Systems Engineer to design, build, and improve the internal systems that support our growing business.

Working alongside our Staff Systems Engineer, you’ll own automation, integrations, and enterprise platform improvements that make our environment more secure, reliable, and scalable. You’ll partner with IT Operations to turn recurring support issues into durable solutions and work with Security and Internal Automation to help employees build and use technology safely.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on improving systems and processes, rather than primarily managing day-to-day support tickets or office technology. You’ll work across a broad technology environment, make thoughtful technical decisions, and take projects from discovery through implementation and operational handoff.

You’ll report to our Boston-based IT Manager.

This is a US-based role, with a preference for candidates in the Eastern Time Zone to support close collaboration with our Boston-based IT Manager and Staff Systems Engineer. Boston-area candidates would also have opportunities to collaborate in person. Working arrangements will be discussed during the interview process.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the administration and improvement of enterprise platforms, including Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, AWS, and other core IT systems. Review configurations, access, and capabilities to improve security and usability.
  • Design, build, test, document, and maintain automated workflows and integrations that reduce manual work and enable reliable employee self-service.
  • Partner with IT Operations to investigate complex escalations, identify root causes, and replace recurring issues with scalable technical or process improvements.
  • Lead systems engineering projects from requirements gathering through rollout, monitoring, and operational handoff, balancing business needs, security, reliability, and maintenance effort.
  • Work with Security, Internal Automation, business stakeholders, and vendors to support secure use of enterprise technology and internal building in Tines.
  • Contribute to systems, processes, and documentation that support future Federal environment requirements as the program develops.

What you bring with you

  • Eight or more years of relevant IT systems engineering experience, or equivalent experience demonstrating senior-level technical ownership.
  • Strong hands-on administration and engineering experience across multiple enterprise platforms, such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Jira, AWS, identity providers, or endpoint management systems.
  • Experience personally building and maintaining automated workflows, integrations, or self-service solutions, using APIs, scripting, or automation platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, including using logs and command-line tools to investigate complex issues, identify root causes, and implement durable improvements.
  • Sound judgment around access controls, data security, testing, change management, and rollback, with an understanding of build-versus-buy trade-offs and ongoing maintenance.
  • Experience independently delivering technical projects, managing competing priorities, and communicating clearly with engineers, operational teams, and business stakeholders.

Experience that will help you succeed
Previous experience with Tines, GCP, regulated environments, CMMC, FedRAMP, or Microsoft 365 GCC High is helpful but not required. Experience supporting secure enterprise AI adoption or preparing systems documentation for compliance requirements is also valuable.

We’re looking for a capable systems engineer who can learn our environment and contribute to its development, rather than someone who has already used every platform in our stack.

Why join Tines now?
You’ll have the opportunity to use Tines to improve how Tines itself works. As our business grows, you’ll help shape the systems, automations, and practices that support employees across the company. For someone who enjoys building practical solutions, partnering closely with other engineers, and seeing the impact of their work, this role offers meaningful ownership and room to grow.

Target Annual Compensation: Base salary of up to $145,000 + equity

Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

#LI-JF1

#LI-SW1

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

Tines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic features, language, religion or belief, political or any other opinion, membership of a national minority, property, birth, disability, age or sexual orientation.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are…

Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. We develop technology-enabled solutions that help the world move safely and easily. We are fostering the development of safe cities, working with police departments and municipalities to install over 4,000 red-light, speed, and school bus stop arm safety cameras across North America. We are also creating smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for over 8.5 million vehicles. And we are a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year across 50+ individual tolling authorities.

Position Overview

As a Project Manager, you will play a key role in providing world class support to our external clients and internal teams by managing the end-to-end implementation of contracted technical programs and ensuring they are delivered in a timely manner. No challenge will be too big, and no issue will go unsolved! You are responsible for tracking the status of all programs / projects as assigned by working with different stakeholders, managing customer expectations, providing status reports to management, active risk and issue management, and drive risks/issues/actions to closure. You will create and manage project plans, communicate schedules with different stakeholders and ensure successful delivery of all projects and tickets. You will work in a highly collaborative environment with a team that is geographically distributed. You will adhere to agile software development processes accepted by the organization. The candidate should have excellent analytical and interpersonal abilities and always looking to improve process and bring in efficiencies. Performs other duties as required.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Responsible for project management of assigned client implementations.
  • Partner with a cross-functional project team to deliver programs on time, on budget and according to contractual requirements.
  • Develop, distribute, and manage consolidated project plans, status reports, dashboards and communicate with stakeholders.
  • Actively manage risks, issues, actions, and dependencies through closure and communicate to maintain alignment.
  • Partner with the Account Management team to manage customer expectations through concise and timely communication.
  • Compile, track, and report on project financials throughout project lifecycle.
  • Works well in a team and is flexible in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to effectively manage time and shifting priorities for self and delivery team.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2-5 years of project management experience in a fast-paced environment
  • Project Management Professional Certification (PMP) preferred, relevant industry experience and/or client implementation experience can be substituted
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Computer Engineering or Management Information Systems Degree required
  • Experience in coaching, leading and influencing others
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience in managing projects and schedules using Microsoft Project
  • Must understand the agile development methodology, applicable roles, and processes
  • Experienced with Office products like Excel, PowerPoint to generate reports and dashboards
  • Experienced with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence
  • Strong problem-resolution, analytical skills, and stakeholder management expertise
  • Flexible and adaptable about learning, task assignments, and learning new technologies
  • Some experience with Project Portfolio Management (PPM) tools like Planview, Mavenlink, etc.
  • Agile Scrum Software Development practices and tools preferred.

Where you’ll be working

In this remote role, you'll have the flexibility to work from home full-time, allowing you to create an optimal work environment. You’ll also have regular check-ins and team meetings scheduled through virtual platforms to ensure collaboration and support

Verra Mobility Values

An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
  • Do What’s Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
  • Lead with Grace. We express humility and compassion, and we are authentic and candid. Our employees demonstrate self-awareness, care for others, instill trust, and communicate effectively.
  • Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.

jobs.jobDescription:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Software Engineering to lead Women’s Health engineering at Oura.Women’s Health is one of Oura’s most important opportunities to help members understand, navigate, and act on their health across meaningful life stages and conditions. In this role, you will lead the engineering organization that turns that ambition into trusted, high-impact consumer experiences.This is a role for a product-minded engineering leader who can do two things at once: ship key initiatives that make meaningful progress toward member outcomes, and transform how the organization builds software through AI-native and agentic workflows.You will partner closely with Product, Design, Science, Data Science, Clinical, Regulatory, and other functions. You will shape the engineering strategy, organization, operating model, and leadership system needed to build excellent products at scale.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead and develop the Women’s Health software engineering organization through engineering managers, directors, and key technical leaders.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Science, Data Science, Clinical, and Regulatory leaders to turn member needs and product strategy into a coherent, high-quality roadmap.
  • Ship the highest-priority initiatives and ensure they make meaningful progress toward member outcomes—not only delivery milestones.
  • Build an organization that consistently ships excellent consumer software with measurable impact for members, by creating clarity across team ownership, architecture, dependencies, decision-making, and priorities.
  • Lead organizational transformation while maintaining delivery momentum and team health.
  • Set and consistently reinforce a high performance bar across Engineering and the broader Women’s Health organization, including outcomes, technical quality, execution, collaboration, and leadership.
  • Define and implement an AI-native approach to product development and software engineering, including practical use of AI and agents, quality guardrails, and measurable outcomes.
  • Build a strong leadership bench through hiring, coaching, feedback, talent development, and thoughtful succession planning.
  • Represent engineering in senior cross-functional planning and help Oura make sound trade-offs between speed, quality, trust, and long-term leverage.

This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based in San Francisco, NY or Boston.

What you'll bring

  • 10–15 years of experience in building software products, ideally 5+ years in leadership.
  • A track record of shipping consumer software that created meaningful, measurable impact for users or members.
  • Experience building and scaling a strong product-building organization, including hiring and developing leaders and managing through managers.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation: changing structures, operating models, culture, or ways of working while maintaining delivery.
  • A clear and practical perspective on how to build a winning software organization in the age of AI and agents.
  • Excellent people leadership skills, including coaching, feedback, performance management, talent development, and inclusive leadership.
  • Strong technical and product judgment, with enough depth to make sound trade-offs across architecture, platform, data, quality, reliability, privacy, and speed.
  • Genuine interest in Women’s Health and the motivation to learn the domain deeply and serve members with empathy.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in Women’s Health, reproductive health, menopause, postpartum, fertility, or adjacent health domains.
  • Experience with regulated, clinically adjacent, or high-trust consumer products.
  • Experience with wearables, connected devices, mobile products, or longitudinal health data.
  • Experience leading AI-enabled product development or AI-native engineering transformation.
  • Experience leading distributed, international, or cross-time-zone organizations.

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave

Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Region 1 $261,800 - $308,000

Region 2 $236,300 - $278,000

Region 3 $212,500 - $250,000

A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location.

We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI).

ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers!
We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note:

  • Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards.
  • We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront.
  • Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email.

Stay cautious and protect your personal details.

To all recruitment agencies: ŌURA does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ŌURA employees, or any other organization's location. ŌURA is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

This is a remote role that must be based in MST or PST.

About the Role

You'll join as a founding member of Tines’ forward deployed team, embedded directly with our most strategic enterprise customers to drive transformational AI adoption. Your job is to realize maximum potential for Tines’ customers and to ensure every stakeholder from end user to customer leadership understands and fully realizes the value of Tines.

You own the full arc of a customer's success: from deepening adoption and enabling stakeholders through to discovering new opportunities where the platform can create measurable business impact. You’ll show customers the art of what's possible and ensuring the value delivered today is only the beginning. You'll be the person customers trust most to make the Tines’ platform work for them in practice.

We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive in ambiguity and represent us at the highest level inside customer environments. You'll be as comfortable deep in a customer's technical environment as you are leading a training session with a non-technical team or presenting a business case to a CTO.

What you will be doing:

  • Own end-to-end deployment: Lead the technical implementation of Tines’ platform within complex enterprise environments. Integrating with existing systems, configuring for customer-specific workflows and ensuring a fast, smooth path to deliverable outcomes.
  • Drive adoption across the organisation: Proactively support and train users and stakeholders in the customer at every level from hands-on technical teams to business leaders ensuring the platform is understood actively used and maximized.
  • Identify and develop new use cases: Through deep familiarity with each customer's business, continuously surface new opportunities where Tines’ platform can create additional value expanding adoption across teams, workflows, and business units.
  • Be the primary technical point of contact: Serve as the customer's trusted advisor on all things platform-related. Troubleshooting issues, delivering workshops, answering technical questions and resolving blockers before they become problems.
  • Maintain strong customer relationships: Build lasting partnerships at every level of the organisation, from daily users to executive sponsors with a focus on long-term retention and growth.
  • Feed insights back to the product: Codify what you learn in the field. Surfacing recurring friction points, unmet needs and high-value use cases and sharing these with Tines’ internal teams such as Engineering, Product and GTM.
  • Travel 20–40% to customer sites to build trust, accelerate adoption and deepen relationships in person.

What you Bring with you:

  • 8+ years in a technical, customer-facing role: Solutions / Pre-sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, Customer Success Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Integration / Implementation Engineer or Software Engineer with customer exposure
  • Proven track record of driving adoption and delivering measurable value from complex technical products inside enterprise environments
  • Strong engineering skills to own integrations, troubleshoot production issues and understand customer infrastructure
  • Strong Python skills (plus ideally TypeScript, Java, or similar)
  • Production experience with LLMs and AI systems: prompt engineering, agent workflows, and deployment at scale
  • Ability to train, enable and influence stakeholders across all levels
  • High agency and resourcefulness: you find a path forward independently, escalate only when necessary, and take full ownership of your accounts
  • Strong communication skills: clear, confident, and low-ego: you make complex things feel simple
  • Willingness to travel 20–40% to customer sites

Target Annual Compensation: $220-240K OTE (90/10 split)

Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

#LI-SW1

Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

jobs.jobDescription:
Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

About the Role

Brain Co. builds AI systems that help institutions carry out complex work. Our government offering, GovOS, connects agency workflows across existing software, documents and data so staff can spend more time serving the public.

Our government business is expanding from early deployments into larger state engagements. We are looking for a senior commercial leader who can turn agency priorities into funded work, build lasting client relationships and help make successful solutions repeatable across states.

You will own new business and account growth across a defined portfolio of U.S. states. This is a senior individual contributor role with a personal revenue target and responsibility for the full sales cycle. You will work directly with agency executives to identify consequential problems, develop the business case and secure agreements that our product and deployment teams can deliver. You will work closely with SLED leadership, engineering and deployment teams to turn initial engagements into broader relationships and expanded scopes of service.

What You Will Do

  • Create demand. Open doors and build pipeline through targeted outreach, executive relationships, industry networks, conferences and collaboration with our partnership leads. Help shape our pitch and narrative, choose the right accounts and turn substantive conversations into qualified opportunities.

  • Build trusted relationships. Earn the trust of agency heads, deputy secretaries, CIOs, budget owners and program leaders. Understand operational priorities and build support across the people who fund, approve and use a solution.

  • Discover and build the value case. Turn ambiguous needs into a clear opportunity. Understand the workflow, quantify potential benefits, identify an executive sponsor and establish a credible funding and purchasing path.

  • Shape the engagement. Partner with product, engineering and deployment to define scope, pricing and success measures. Align commitments with delivery capacity and the potential to reuse capabilities across customers.

  • Lead the deal through close. Own proposals, buyer coordination and negotiations. Coordinate technical, legal and commercial input, address security and integration requirements early, and navigate state budget cycles and procurement routes, including solicitations, reseller and cooperative contracts, and other authorized purchasing mechanisms.

  • Grow the account. Stay engaged after signature as the commercial relationship owner. Partner with deployment leaders to connect demonstrated results to references, renewals and expansion into additional agency workflows.

  • Build a repeatable sales motion. Keep account plans, forecasts and next steps accurate. Share customer needs and buying signals, strengthen our positioning and improve how we pursue and win future engagements.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of relevant experience. You bring 10+ years of relevant experience in the public sector, ideally at the state level of government, enterprise technology sales, public-sector consulting or transformation, with substantial work involving U.S. state agencies and direct accountability for winning and growing business.

  • Complex seven-figure closes. You’ve personally originated, shaped and closed custom technology deployments or tailored technology engagements. You can explain your role in building the value case, securing budget, aligning decision-makers, negotiating scope and contracts, aligning delivery commitments and turning an initial engagement into a larger relationship.

  • State-government experience and domain depth. You understand agency priorities, institutional constraints and how states buy technology and services, including funding cycles, solicitations, contract vehicles, legal review and security approvals. You can distinguish a promising conversation from a qualified opportunity.

  • Executive credibility. You serve as a trusted adviser to senior government leaders, lead difficult conversations with sound judgment and remain credible with both political appointees and career officials.

  • Analytical and commercial judgment. You can move from an open-ended agency challenge to a practical solution, a quantified business case and a concise recommendation that executives can act on.

  • AI and technology fluency. You can discuss AI capabilities, data, integrations and implementation tradeoffs with executives and engineers. You ask precise questions and make commitments grounded in what the team can deliver.

  • Execution and ownership. You create your own pipeline, produce strong proposals and presentations, and keep complex pursuits moving. You lead across teams without formal authority and operate effectively while the product and sales approach are evolving.

  • Commitment to public service. You work effectively across administrations and understand the importance of earning trust through results, professional judgment and responsible use of technology.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in state administration, procurement, transportation, environmental permitting, budgeting or legal and regulatory workflows.

  • Experience bringing a new AI or software offering to market, or selling through resellers, systems integrators and public-sector contract vehicles.

What Success Looks Like

You meet your bookings and account-growth goals with well-qualified opportunities and reliable forecasts. Initial engagements lead to production use, strong references and expansion. The work you win helps Brain Co. serve additional agencies with reusable capabilities and less custom development, while maintaining credible customer commitments.

Location and Travel

San Francisco, New York, or Remote. Regular travel to customer sites is expected (30-50%).
