We're building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using…
jobs.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We're building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow's machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers love building great things with passionate teammates. We value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action, whether it's a big initiative or a small fix. You're naturally curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer to show your work over talking about it. Many of us have founder mindsets and thrive in Roboflow's high-autonomy environment.

What We're Looking For

Primarily, you like to make great things with passionate colleagues. You are someone that likes to own outcomes, not only inputs. You're motivated by having responsibility and accountability. You're eager to 'do the work,' big and small.

This role suits someone who has run IT at a startup, likes automating repetitive work away, and wants real ownership rather than a ticket queue.

What You'll Do

As our IT Operations Engineer, you'll own corporate IT end to end: identity, devices, SaaS, and the employee lifecycle from first day to last. You'll own how Roboflowers get set up, stay productive, and get offboarded cleanly.

We serve some of the world's largest enterprise companies like Rivian, Pella, Chobani and BNSF, so smooth and secure IT is a shared priority across the company. You'll be the second member of our IT and security function, working alongside our first Security & Automation Engineer as part of our Infrastructure organization. They'll own the security program and audits, and you support it with the day-to-day controls and evidence.

Skillset

Required:

  • 3-5 years in IT operations or systems administration, including at least 1-2 years at a startup or small, fast-moving team

  • Hands-on admin experience with Okta or a similar SSO provider (Microsoft Entra ID, OneLogin, JumpCloud)

  • Proven macOS fleet management with an MDM (Kandji, Mosyle, Jamf, Intune, or similar)

  • Google Workspace administration

  • Scripting ability (Python, Bash, or similar) and a habit of automating repeated tasks

  • Clear written communication; you document as you go

Nice to have:

  • Supported a SOC 2, HIPAA, or ISO 27001 audit, or used a compliance platform like Secureframe, Vanta, or Drata

  • Okta Workflows or other no-code automation tools

  • Linux familiarity and basic GCP or AWS IAM

  • Experience supporting a remote team across time zones

What this role is not:

  • Not Windows administration: we run macOS and Linux

  • Not traditional enterprise networking: we're cloud-first with minimal on-prem infrastructure beyond our office hubs

A Glimpse of Your Work

Identity and access:

  • Administer Okta (or our SSO provider): app integrations, groups, provisioning and deprovisioning, and MFA policy

  • Run access requests and periodic access reviews across Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, GCP, and our other SaaS tools

Devices:

  • Own our macOS fleet through MDM: enrollment, configuration profiles, OS and app patching, and encryption

  • Handle laptop procurement, shipping, inventory, and recovery for a distributed team across the US and Europe

Employee lifecycle and support:

  • Own onboarding and offboarding end to end, so new hires are productive on day one and departures are fully closed out the same day

  • Be the go-to person for hardware, software, and account issues, and turn recurring questions into docs or self-serve fixes

  • Support office IT (Wi-Fi, conference rooms, printers) at our New York and San Francisco hubs

Automation:

  • Script and automate repetitive IT work (for example, onboarding workflows, provisioning, and device compliance checks) using tools like Python, shell scripts, Okta Workflows, or HRIS integrations

  • Keep IT procedures, runbooks, and the asset inventory current

SaaS and vendors:

  • Manage the SaaS stack: licenses, renewals, spend, and removing unused seats

  • Evaluate new tools and vendors with the Security & Automation Engineer

Security and compliance support:

  • Keep IT controls healthy day to day (device compliance, access reviews, offboarding checks) and follow up on exceptions

  • Collect and organize audit evidence for SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, and future frameworks

  • Help roll out security awareness training and phishing simulations

Who You'll Be Working With

Our team of ~100 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

You will directly be working with our Engineering Lead, our Security & Automation Engineer, and a team of product, infrastructure, and security engineers.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team on-sites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You'll Work

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you'll be expected to attend each week. Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

  • $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

  • $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

  • $350/mo AI Tools stipend

  • $150/mo team lunch stipend

  • $500/one time home office stipend

  • Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

  • Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process (~4 hours)

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. You will be speaking directly with our team about what it's like to work and thrive at Roboflow. Each conversation is a separate session.

Before the Interview:

  • We'll review your application, LinkedIn, GitHub, etc.

Introduction Phase:

  • [30m] Meet with Recruiting to talk through your background, what you've owned, motivation, location, compensation, and role expectations.

  • [30-45m] Meet with the hiring manager, a member of our IT team, to get to know more about the role, allow us to get to know you better, and ensure it's a good fit for both parties to continue moving forward in the process.

Team Interview Phase:

  • [60m] Technical interview covering identity and SSO, macOS fleet management, office and SaaS operations, and automation.

  • [75m] Operations exercise with the technical interviewer and a peer: troubleshooting and execution using a set of records we supply.

Ask questions!

Final Interview Stage:

  • [45m] Meet with our Security lead and a cross-functional partner to discuss delegated security work, evidence quality, escalation, and handoffs with People and Operations.

  • We check references and conduct a background check.

Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can.

Learn More About Us

We are building a diverse Distributed team that is distributed across the globe. Roboflow is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

We provide competitive compensation and stellar benefits to accelerate your personal and work life. Learn more about what it is like to work at Roboflow by reading these blog posts.

See our careers page for all open listings.

jobs.jobTitle: People Systems, Analytics, and AI Manager
jobs.jobExcerpt: About the Job: LaunchDarkly is seeking a People Systems, Analytics and AI Manager to be our subject matter expert on HR systems and to turn People data into insights that help business leaders make better decisions. You will build the reports, analytics, and dashboards that tell the story of our workforce, and you will use…
jobs.jobDescription:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is seeking a People Systems, Analytics and AI Manager to be our subject matter expert on HR systems and to turn People data into insights that help business leaders make better decisions. You will build the reports, analytics, and dashboards that tell the story of our workforce, and you will use AI tooling to make those stories faster to create, easier to understand, and more compelling.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, People Programs, Systems and Analytics. You will work closely with People Operations, Finance, and leaders across the business, and you will own your work from question to insight to action.

We are looking for someone who combines deep HR systems knowledge with strong analytical skills, creativity in how data is presented, and sound judgment about people data and AI.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for our HR systems (HRIS, applicant tracking, performance, compensation, and learning platforms), including configuration, data integrity, security roles, integrations, and release management.
  • Design, build, and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytics on headcount, hiring, retention, engagement, compensation, and workforce planning that leaders use to make decisions.
  • Partner with People, Finance, and business leaders to translate questions into clear metrics, definitions, and analyses, and to recommend actions based on what the data shows.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate analysis and create compelling data stories and visualizations, including automated insights, natural-language summaries, and executive-ready narratives.
  • Establish and govern People data standards: metric definitions, data quality checks, documentation, and a single source of truth across systems.
  • Protect employee data by applying privacy, confidentiality, and access controls, and by partnering with Legal and Security on responsible use of AI with People data.
  • Own the intake, prioritization, and delivery of system and reporting requests, balancing quick turnarounds with scalable, self-service solutions.
  • Automate recurring reports and manual workflows to reduce effort and errors, and identify new opportunities where systems and AI can improve the employee and manager experience.
  • Support system projects such as new module rollouts, integrations, data migrations, and annual cycles (performance, compensation, and engagement), including testing, training, and documentation.
  • Enable People Operations teammates and managers through training, office hours, and clear guides so they can use data and tools with confidence.
  • Stay current on HR technology, analytics, and AI trends, and bring practical recommendations to the Director, People Programs, Systems and Analytics.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of related experience in HR systems, People analytics, or HR operations, with hands-on ownership of reporting and dashboards in a technology or high-growth environment.
  • Expert-level knowledge of at least one major HRIS (for example, Workday, Rippling, or similar), including report writing, calculated fields, and security configuration.
  • Strong proficiency with analytics and visualization tools (for example, SQL, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar) and advanced spreadsheet skills.
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tooling to analyze data, generate insights, and build visualizations and narratives, with sound judgment about accuracy and appropriate use.
  • Ability to translate business questions into metrics and communicate findings clearly to non-technical leaders.
  • Strong understanding of data integrity, privacy, and confidentiality practices for employee data.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders independently and deliver on time with attention to detail.
  • Curious, pragmatic problem solver who enjoys simplifying complex processes and data.
  • Comfortable working with a highly distributed team across time zones.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with data pipelines, data warehouses, or scripting (for example, Python or dbt).
  • Experience with integrations and workflow automation tools.
  • Knowledge of workforce planning, compensation, or engagement analytics.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Analytics, Business, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $121,800 - $167,530**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $109,700 - $150,810**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $103,600 - $142,450**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com.

Do you need a disability accommodation?

Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @LaunchDarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit Careers | LaunchDarkly directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.

Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to careers@launchdarkly.com.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical…
jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: Washington, Oregon, California, Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Colorado, New Mexico, Arizona, Utah. The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue

  • All candidates must be located in one of the following states: Washington, Oregon, California, Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Colorado, New Mexico, Arizona, Utah

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary

$152,000—$190,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work…
jobs.jobDescription:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About the Role:

Headway is already the largest mental health network for America's leading health plans. Very few marketing leaders get to operate at a scale where their work materially shapes how mental health care works in America. This is that role.

We're looking for a Director of Payer Marketing to build and lead the function that makes Headway the most credible, trusted voice in the room whenever a payer talks about mental health. This is an enterprise B2B product marketing leader at heart — someone who translates narrative to commercial leverage, knows their audience backwards and forwards, and understands how that work builds towards outcomes: deeper relationships, stronger renewals, expanded partnerships, and better terms.

This is a player-coach role for someone who is a builder at heart. You'll set the payer-marketing strategy, build and lead a small, high-caliber team, and work hand-in-hand with our Payer/Commercial, Clinical Strategy, and Provider, Patient & Brand marketing teams.

What you'll own:

  • Set the payer marketing strategy. Define the overarching positioning, narrative, and GTM plan for Headway with health plans. The payer story is never just a payer story; it's the synthesis of everything Headway is doing across the platform.

  • Build the function from zero. This isn't a role where you inherit a playbook — you'll define the operating model, the team structure, the cadences, and the metrics that make payer marketing a true commercial lever. You'll create milestones without being handed a roadmap and build momentum in ambiguous, high-stakes situations.

  • Build the category story everyone wants to be part of. Author a point of view so strong that plans, providers, and partners orient around it.

  • Commercialize net-new payer solutions. Partner with Product and Payer/Commercial to take new Headway offerings to market. Define what's buyable, build the proof and positioning that moves a plan from curious to committed, and orchestrate the launch moments that convert the plan relationships you've earned into net-new revenue.

  • Turn clinical data into proof, and proof into leverage. Partner with Clinical Strategy and Research to source evidence and translate complex data into compelling outcomes narratives, benchmarks, and a steady drumbeat of Headway-authored insight (data stories, trend reports, category POV).

  • Drive field marketing and enablement. Ensure Payer/Commercial has the content library, pitch decks, RFP support, case studies, and tools to grow and deepen accounts.

  • Activate the story in the right rooms. Plan and execute the moments that bring the narrative to life — conference presence and customer events, executive experiences and meetings, partner co-presentations, and "to-and-through-the-payer" enablement that equips plans to market Headway to their own members during open enrollment and AEP.

  • Keep us on offense with competitive intelligence. Track how competitors and adjacent players (EAPs, telehealth, MSOs, vertically integrated incumbents) position to payers, and arm leadership and commercial teams with sharp, current narratives.

  • Measure leverage, not just funnel. Define success around relationship depth and commercial impact.

You'd be a great fit if…

  • You're an enterprise B2B product marketing leader with 10+ years of experience (including 5+ years managing teams), and a track record where positioning, messaging, GTM, enablement, and competitive intel are your core craft — not adjacent skills.

  • You have experience in or adjacent to health plans, value-based care, or complex B2B healthcare environments — and you're the kind of person who gets deeply curious about the nuances of a new audience fast. Knowing your audience cold is the outcome we're hiring for; the path to get there can vary.

  • You can point to work where marketing moved commercial outcomes — win rates, deal terms, expansion, preferred status — not just awareness or reputation. You think about narrative as leverage.

  • You've done expand-after-land marketing at enterprise scale — you know how to take a solution a customer has never bought before and build the commercial case, the sales enablement, and the launch moment that gets them to commit dollars to it. You don't just deepen relationships; you convert them into new product revenue.

  • You have strong customer-first instincts and can influence without authority, especially in ambiguous, high-stakes moments.

  • You're energized by fast-moving environments — comfortable with complexity, undeterred by uncertainty.

  • You've built from scratch — a function, a process, a go-to-market motion — not just optimized within a system someone else stood up. You know how to create structure in ambiguity.

  • You're proactively curious — you'd ask to sit in on a payer call, shadow a commercial conversation, or join a leadership meeting just to build your own mental model of the landscape. You don't wait to be briefed.

  • You're naturally multi-threaded internally. You seek out the patient team's roadmap and the provider go-to-market because you know the payer story can only be as strong as your grasp of the whole platform.

This is a rare moment — Headway is at the inflection point where scale meets credibility, and the person who builds this function will leave a lasting mark on how behavioral health is delivered and funded in America. If that sounds like the challenge you've been waiting for, we'd love to meet you.

Comprehensive benefits:

Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What You’ll Do:

As a highly skilled and customer-focused Solutions Architect, you will play a critical role in working alongside our sales team to engage prospects, qualify opportunities, and design edge-based computer vision solutions. As the primary technical resource in the pre-sales phase, the Solutions Architect will help identify prospective client needs, define technical requirements, and create compelling, scalable solutions that leverage our cutting-edge computer vision platform.

Role and Responsibilities:

  • Opportunity Qualification: Collaborate with sales representatives to assess the technical feasibility and compatibility of potential projects with our computer vision solutions. Act as a trusted advisor to clients, understanding their business objectives, technical constraints, and use cases.

  • Solution Design: Design tailored solutions that meet customer requirements by selecting and integrating appropriate components across hardware, software, and edge deployment configurations. Ensure that solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with industry best practices for computer vision.

  • Technical Expertise: Maintain an in-depth knowledge of our computer vision platform, including its technical specifications, deployment methodologies, and customization options. Provide guidance on edge deployments, data handling, model inference, and integrations with client infrastructure.

  • Demo and Proof of Concept (POC): Lead technical demonstrations and POCs to showcase product capabilities and benefits. This includes configuring demo environments, guiding clients through the technology, and troubleshooting any technical issues.

  • Customer Engagement: Act as a primary point of contact for technical discussions, addressing client inquiries about the product’s architecture, APIs, security, scalability, and deployment scenarios.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to provide customer feedback, identify product improvements, and advocate for features that would enhance our solution’s ability to meet client needs.

The Skillset You’ll Bring:

  • Experience in solutions architecture, technical sales engineering, or related role, preferably in a computer vision, AI, or IoT-focused company.

  • Industry experience working directly in or with one or more of Roboflow’s target markets, including but not limited to manufacturing, automotive, logistics, food processing, retail

  • Expertise in designing edge-based solutions and understanding of the unique constraints and challenges associated with edge computing.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-oriented solutions for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong knowledge of computer vision, machine learning, and associated technologies.

  • Experience with cloud and edge infrastructure, ideally including AWS, Azure IoT, or other edge platforms.

  • Proficiency in scripting or programming languages like Python and JavaScript

  • Willingness to travel ~40%

Preferred Attributes:

  • Experience working within a pre-sales or go-to-market team.

  • Familiarity with common data processing and computer vision frameworks (e.g., OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch).

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a customer-centric approach and the ability to think on your feet.

Who You'll Be Working With

Our team of ~120 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

As a Solutions Architect hire, you’ll be partnering directly with our co-founder/CEO and Sales leadership to not only do great work in the role, but shape how this function works for the future of Roboflow.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and São Paulo (with plans to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You'll Work

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week. Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

The target OTE for this role is $170,000-$240,000

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

  • $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

  • $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

  • $350/mo AI Tools

  • $150/mo Team lunch

  • $500/one time Home office

  • Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

  • Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process (~5 hours)

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We are all motivated to work with an exceptional team, who you’ll be speaking directly with about what it's like to work and thrive at Roboflow. We like to be decisive and work fast, so don't be surprised if all the below conversations happen over a few days.

Before the Interview:

  • We’ll review your application, LinkedIn, Github, etc.

  • The best way to stand out is to write about something you’ve built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

  • We may send you a technical screen if applicable.

Introduction Phase:

  • [45m] Meet with hiring manager to assess for overall mindset and skillset

Team Interview Phase:

  • [60m] Technical Assessment - meet with fellow implementation Engineer

  • [30m] Demo - build a project with Roboflow and share your work

Final Interview Stage:

  • [30m] Meet with Head of Operations, for a culture discussion

  • [30m] Meet with Joseph Nelson, CEO

Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can.

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role or subscribe to our career newsletter by emailing "Subscribe" to operations@roboflow.com. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

Learn More About Us

We are building a diverse Distributed team that is distributed across the globe. Roboflow is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

We provide competitive compensation and stellar benefits to accelerate your personal and work life. Learn more about what it is like to work at Roboflow by reading these blog posts.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere—and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

About the Job:

The Mid-Market Account Executive will drive LaunchDarkly's growth across a blended book of net-new and existing accounts. Acting as the "quarterback" for a defined book of business, you will develop and execute account strategies, run technical discovery and proof-of-concept cycles, and help customers successfully test, purchase, and adopt LaunchDarkly's platform.

Responsibilities:

  • Pipeline Generation: Qualify and convert inbound leads at a rapid pace while prospecting into ICP target accounts.
  • Value Articulation: Articulate and sell the value of LaunchDarkly's platform subscriptions and usage-based pricing model.
  • Technical Discovery: Prepare for and run discovery sessions with prospects to surface core use cases and align pricing to third-party architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Solution Demonstration: Customize and deliver demos with the Solutions Engineering team, and run proofs of concept for prospects.
  • Account Expansion: Own, build, and develop relationships with existing customers, uncovering and developing new opportunities within the install base.
  • Customer Success: Educate, evangelize, and guide customers through successful adoption, delivering their feedback back to Product and Engineering.
  • Revenue Growth: Consistently hit revenue targets across both net-new and expansion motions.
  • Collaboration: Work with your manager, Sales Engineers, and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution and customer success.
  • Strategic Thinking & Execution:
    • Design and execute account strategies that balance net-new acquisition with expansion of existing customers.
    • Identify and capitalize on usage-based pricing signals and third-party architecture fit to prioritize opportunities.
    • Adapt strategies as customer needs and market dynamics evolve, ensuring continuous growth and a competitive edge.
  • Full-Cycle Sales Expertise:
    • Proven track record managing a full sales cycle, from inbound qualification and prospecting through close and expansion.
    • Deep understanding of usage-based pricing models and the ability to manage discovery, demo, and proof-of-concept stages.
    • Skilled in selling to Engineering Leaders, Platform Teams, CTOs, CIOs, and other technical decision-makers.
  • Customer-Centric Problem Solving:
    • Assess customer pain points and design tailored solutions, including proofs of concept, that create measurable value.
    • Build long-term relationships with existing customers, acting as a trusted advisor who drives product adoption.
    • Overcome obstacles and find innovative ways to expand LaunchDarkly's footprint within an account.
  • Independent Decision Making:
    • Work autonomously with minimal day-to-day supervision, making sound decisions based on account signals and data.
    • Take ownership of your book of business, managing both acquisition and expansion motions with confidence.
    • Prioritize tasks and make decisions quickly, ensuring alignment with broader revenue goals.
  • Analytical Skills & Data-Driven Insights:
    • Gain and apply an understanding of third-party cloud architectures to accurately position and price the usage-based model.
    • Evaluate account signals and customer data to prioritize the accounts most likely to convert or expand.
    • Keep all data current in SFDC, Aviso, and Outreach, and use these tools to track and analyze performance.
  • Negotiation & Deal Structuring:
    • Negotiate platform subscription agreements that balance customer needs with company goals.
    • Create mutually beneficial agreements that support long-term adoption and expansion.
    • Handle objections, overcome resistance, and close deals in a competitive market.
  • Communication & Influence:
    • Exhibit strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and persuade key stakeholders.
    • Present solutions and negotiate with technical decision-makers, ensuring clear understanding and alignment.
    • Communicate complex, usage-based pricing concepts concisely and compellingly to diverse audiences.
  • Collaboration & Team Leadership:
    • Collaborate effectively with your manager, Sales Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to align efforts and drive growth.
    • Demonstrate leadership in managing internal resources, ensuring alignment with company goals.
    • Motivate and influence team members across departments to achieve common objectives.
  • Results-Driven Focus:
    • Maintain a strong focus on achieving measurable outcomes across both new-logo and expansion revenue.
    • Accurately forecast sales targets on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis.
    • Take ownership for results, holding yourself accountable for hitting quota.

Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of full-cycle sales experience.
  • Proven track record of hitting or exceeding quota.
  • Exceptional written and spoken communicator.
  • Highly organized and autonomous.
  • Comfortable and energized operating in a fast-moving organization.
  • Entrepreneurial and self-motivated.
  • Enthusiastic about learning and growing at LaunchDarkly.
  • Intellectually curious and ambitious.
  • Knowledge or experience in the developer tool space a plus.
  • Experience selling to mid-market companies a plus.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $136,000 - $187,000**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $122,000 - $168,000**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $116,000 - $159,000**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com.

Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @LaunchDarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit Careers | LaunchDarkly directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.

Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to careers@launchdarkly.com.

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

Headway is hiring a Technical Recruiter to build and run our campus recruiting program as we grow the engineering teams powering our next stage of growth. You'll own the day-to-day execution of our university presence — from event programming to offer close — and serve as Headway's primary face to campus talent across technical disciplines.

As a member of the Engineering Recruiting team, you'll operate as a talent partner and collaborator with hiring managers and the broader TA team, driving predictable hiring outcomes in a high-growth environment with a high talent bar. Your work will directly shape Headway's ability to deliver for providers and patients nationwide.

  • Manage the summer internship program end-to-end: driving intern hiring, coordinating project scoping with managers, supporting onboarding, running community programming throughout the summer, and facilitating performance evaluation and return-offer decisions

  • Build initial relationships with universities, career centers, and student organizations, with a focus on technical disciplines across our target school list

  • Run our campus event programming — info sessions, career fairs, hackathons, and diversity-focused events — with a sharp eye on ROI and a bias toward doubling down on what works

  • Support full-cycle searches for new grad and intern roles, spanning aggressive top-of-funnel sourcing and strategic close motions in late stages

  • Act as a strategic and adaptable partner to hiring managers, quickly refining approach and process as needed to accelerate progress

  • Ensure every candidate follows a consistent, structured, inclusive process that raises the hiring bar and improves consistency across teams

  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience through every step of the process

You’d be a great fit if you…

  • Bring 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including meaningful time in campus or university recruiting (in-house, agency, or relevant experience even if you didn’t carry the TA title)

  • Have a track record of building and managing university relationships and running campus event programs that actually convert

  • Operate as a strategic and positive partner to your stakeholders, maintaining progress and acting as a true collaborator even in moments of ambiguity

  • Can break down complex programs into clear execution plans, diagnosing challenges and proposing solutions proactively

  • Manage multiple workstreams with structure, balancing high volume with attention to detail and predictable execution — especially across a program with seasonal spikes

  • Think creatively about sourcing and outreach to find and engage top early-career technical talent

  • Care about candidate experience and community-building, not just pipeline throughput

  • Communicate clearly and with presence, whether aligning with hiring managers, pitching Headway on campus, or guiding candidates through the process

  • Pragmatic Security: Awareness of security best practices for cloud operations and how they can be applied to startup environments.

  • Fixing security vulnerabilities and bugs

  • Hardening our systems and processes to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR requirements, making us audit-ready.

  • Participating in an on-call rotation to ensure platform reliability.

About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is redefining how modern software is built and operated. As AI transforms software development, we believe the future belongs to organizations that can move at AI speed while maintaining control in production. We're looking for a strategic external communications leader to help make that vision impossible to ignore.

As Head of Corporate Marketing, you'll lead the team responsible for translating our company strategy into a cohesive market narrative that influences customers, analysts, media, developers, and industry leaders. You'll own our external communications strategy across public relations, analyst relations, social media, and executive communications while partnering closely with Product Marketing, Content Marketing, Demand Generation, and our executive team to ensure every external touchpoint reinforces the same story.

This role is ideal for someone who thinks beyond communications channels and is energized by shaping markets, influencing industry conversations, and building category leadership.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with executive leadership to operationalize LaunchDarkly's corporate narrative.
  • Increase LaunchDarkly's share of voice and thought leadership across developer and engineering leader audiences technology executives, analysts, and industry influencers.
  • Ensure consistent messaging across communications, product launches, thought leadership, analyst engagements, and executive visibility.
  • Build repeatable processes that align communications efforts around a unified strategic story rather than individual functional priorities.
  • Identify emerging market conversations and flag opportunities for LaunchDarkly engagement..
  • Lead and develop a team of three spanning Public Relations, Analyst Relations, and Social Media, creating a high-performing organization focused on influence, quality, and business impact.
  • Manage thought-leadership programs for the CEO, CTO, SVP of Product and other key executives to position LaunchDarkly leaders as trusted authorities on software delivery, AI, and modern engineering.
  • Identify speaking opportunities, contributed content, media engagements, and strategic platforms that reinforce our market position.
  • Support analyst relations efforts with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, RedMonk, and other key firms by ensuring consistent, accurate messaging on LaunchDarkly's products and differentiation..
  • Define and track communications metrics across share of voice, analyst perception, executive visibility, and market influence and surface insights to inform strategy.

Qualifications:

  • Typically brings 15+ years of experience in corporate communications, product communications, corporate marketing, or related leadership roles within high-growth B2B software companies and 5 years of leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated success building integrated communications strategies that strengthen market positioning, thought leadership, and executive visibility.
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing communications organizations across multiple disciplines, including public relations, analyst relations, executive communications, and/or social media.
  • Strong point of view on how modern B2B technology companies build market influence beyond traditional public relations.
  • Exceptional storytelling, messaging, and executive communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling market narratives.
  • (Preferred) Background in developer tools, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, or enterprise software serving technical audiences.
  • (Preferred) Experience supporting category creation, major market repositioning efforts, or new product category launches.
  • (Preferred) Experience partnering closely with Product Marketing and executive leadership to shape corporate positioning and thought leadership.

Specific Requirements:

  • 20% travel required
  • Must be authorized to work in US / Canada (no visa sponsorship / relocation)
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Journalism, or a related field preferred.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level M4:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $214,800 - $295,350**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $193,400 - $265,870**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $182,600 - $251,020**
  • All ranges are inclusive of a 15% bonus

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

jobs.jobDescription:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About the Role

As Headway's Senior Accounting Manager, you will lead day-to-day accounting operations and help establish scalable financial processes during a period of rapid growth. You'll manage a team of four accountants, owning month-end close, financial reporting, and technical accounting under US GAAP. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll coach a high-performing team while partnering cross-functionally with Finance, People, Legal, Data, Product, and Engineering to ensure accurate and timely reporting. This role offers an opportunity to apply strong leadership, technical accounting expertise, and creative problem-solving to make a lasting impact on Headway's operations and audit readiness.

You will:

  • Manage and develop a team of 3+ accountants — setting priorities, reviewing work, providing feedback, and coaching them on technical accounting and process improvements.

  • Take a lead in automating accounting workflows using AI and LLMs (e.g., journal entry preparation, reconciliations, flux analysis, audit support), and lead the team in adopting these tools responsibly.

  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close process end-to-end, ensuring journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, and account analyses are accurate, complete, and delivered on schedule.

  • Review and approve journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and flux analyses prepared by the team.

  • Lead technical accounting research and policy setting under US GAAP, including documenting accounting positions and memos for complex transactions

  • Support the annual audit by coordinating PBC requests and responses across the team, partnering with the Assistant Controller (who serves as the primary point of contact for external auditors.)

  • Partner with the People team to oversee payroll accounting and reconciliations, and with cross-functional teams (Finance, Data, Engineering, Product) to scale accounting operations.

  • Drive process improvements and automation initiatives across the accounting function, leveraging tools like Netsuite, Workday, and Ramp to reduce manual work and improve controls.

  • Lead or sponsor strategic accounting projects, coordinating cross-functional partners and delivering measurable business impact.

You'd be great for this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of accounting and/or audit experience, including at least 5 years managing a team

  • A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or another relevant field (CPA preferred but not required)

  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and experience leading month-end close in a high-growth environment

  • Public accounting (Big 4 or large firm) and/or in-house experience at a high-growth or pre-IPO company

  • History of utilizing LLM’s such as Claude to automate processes.

  • A track record of coaching and developing accounting talent

  • Hands-on experience with Netsuite (and ideally Numeric and Ramp), and a bias toward using technology to scale accounting operations

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and partner effectively across functions

  • A proactive, ownership mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

Comprehensive benefits:

Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave.

We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. jobs.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What You'll Do

This is a senior role for someone who has already shipped products real people love and is ready to own entire product surfaces from idea to impact.

You'll be tasked with a large variety of projects. We're still small enough that engineers are expected to have a wide skillset and go from idea conception to feature success. We're looking for product engineers, people whose instinct is to ask "what should we build and why" before "how do we build it." You're technical enough to ship the whole thing yourself, but your superpower is product judgment, user empathy, and taste. You have strong opinions about product details — loading states, empty states, the copy on a button, and you notice friction others miss.

Most of the things we work on are parts of the core product (an end-to-end pipeline for building computer vision projects spanning image ingestion to annotation to training and deployment), but from time to time we're also working on things like integrating marketing and sales tools, automating internal processes, and open source projects.

You'll help set the roadmap, not receive it. You'll be expected to advocate for which projects are the highest priority, contribute directly to strategy decisions, and bring engineers and users along with you. If you need a rigid list of tasks spelled out in a multi-month roadmap, this role won't be a good fit.

Example Projects

  • Identifying a flow our users quietly hate and redesigning it end-to-end.

  • Next-generation model-assisted labeling.

  • Streamlining our onboarding flow.

  • Expanding our annotation tool to support new functionality (like polygonal annotations for image segmentation).

  • Creating a filtering interface so our users can mix and match their images based on metadata like the time of day they were captured, the GPS location, or custom tags they've applied.

  • Integrating the core app with external APIs for things like outsourcing annotation tasks and analyzing deployed model performance.

  • Deeper integrations with our other products like Roboflow Universe and our REST API.

Who You'll Be Working With

Our team of ~120 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

You will directly be working with our Engineering Lead and a team of Engineers.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is fully distributed. We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You'll Work

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week. Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

The target compensation for this role is $165,000 - $195,000.

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

  • $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

  • $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

  • $350/mo AI Tools stipend

  • $150/mo team lunch stipend

  • $500/one time home office stipend

  • Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

  • Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process (6+ hours)

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We are all motivated to work with an exceptional team and don't currently have in-house recruiters. You will be speaking directly with our team about what it's like to work and thrive at Roboflow. We like to be decisive and work fast, so don't be surprised if all the below conversations happen over a day or two.

Introduction Phase:

  • [30m] Meet with hiring manager for introduction to assess overall mindset and skillset.

  • [30m] Team interview on product and business skills.

  • [60m] Collaborate with a Roboflow engineer to ideate and begin building a project with Roboflow.

Build with Roboflow:

  • You will build a small project with Roboflow to showcase your technical and product skills.

Project Demo:

  • [45m] Meet with your hiring manager or our CTO to demo your project

Final Interviews:

  • [45m] Meet with Head of Operations for a culture discussion.

  • [60m / Optional] Meet with CEO.

We call at least 3 references in the final stage of the process. We love it when one of your references is a customer or client you’ve worked with!

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role or subscribe to our career newsletter by emailing "Subscribe" to operations@roboflow.com. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere—and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

About the Job:

AI-powered workflows are only as good as the customer data underneath them. LaunchDarkly helps engineering teams ship software faster and more safely through feature management, experimentation, and AI delivery tooling. As our GTM Data Governance Manager (MDM), you will set the rules that make our core customer data (accounts, contacts, subscriptions, and users) accurate, consistent, and trusted across Salesforce, our billing and finance systems, marketing automation, product usage data, and the data warehouse.

This is an individual contributor role with real ownership of the data model and its standards. You will partner with Data Engineering, GTM Systems, Finance Systems, Legal, and Security to put those standards into production. Your work is the foundation for reliable reporting, accurate territory and segmentation, clean pipeline attribution, and the AI workflows that depend on high-quality data.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the MDM roadmap and operating model for the account, contact, and organization hierarchy domains.
  • Define golden record rules: matching, merging, survivorship, and parent/child hierarchies across CRM, billing, product, and support systems.
  • Set data governance standards, including ownership, stewardship roles, definitions, and quality SLAs, in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success. Run the processes for onboarding new data sources, handling change requests, and managing lifecycle events such as mergers, acquisitions, and customer reorganizations.
  • Design and monitor data quality rules, scorecards, and dashboards covering completeness, accuracy, duplication, and timeliness. Drive remediation and report data health, risks, and progress to leadership with clear metrics and business impact.
  • Specify integration patterns and acceptance criteria across Salesforce, the data warehouse, and enrichment providers, and work with Data Engineering and GTM Systems to build them. Recommend build vs. buy for MDM, identity resolution, enrichment, and data quality tooling.
  • Provide trusted, well-documented data products for analytics and AI use cases. Act as the data owner with Legal and Security on PII handling, GDPR and CCPA requirements, retention, and access controls.
  • Who You'll Work With: Data Engineering and GTM Systems build pipelines and Salesforce configuration. Legal and Security own privacy and security decisions, and you inform them as the data owner. You own the rules, standards, and acceptance criteria that tell everyone else what "correct" looks like.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in data management, data governance, data engineering, or analytics, including 2+ years leading MDM or data quality programs.
  • Hands-on experience designing match, merge, and survivorship rules and golden record or hierarchy models, with results you can describe.
  • Experience with Salesforce data models and CRM data quality at scale.
  • Experience building and operating a data governance framework: policies, stewardship models, and SLAs.
  • Ability to translate business needs into data requirements and explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • A track record of delivering cross-functional programs without direct authority.
