About the role:

You will be the first dedicated PM for pricing at Headway. Your mission: build pricing into a durable, experimentation-driven lever for growth and revenue. Success looks like creating $100M+ of revenue impact.

Headway's pricing decisions affect every participant in our marketplace — what providers earn, what patients pay, and what payers reimburse. Today, these decisions are made through a mix of analysis, intuition, and competitive benchmarks. You'll replace that with a systematic, experiment-driven approach that generates data, builds conviction, and creates new revenue streams through bundling/un-bundling.

This is not a strategy-deck role. You will design experiments, partner with data scientists, navigate cross-functional complexity, and ship pricing changes that move the business. You'll work at the intersection of product, economics, and marketplace dynamics in one of the fastest-growing healthcare companies in the country.

You Will

  • Own pricing experimentation end-to-end: Design, run, and analyze pricing experiments (payout levels, take rates, fee structures, incentive models) with proper controls and measurement.

  • Price and package existing features: Identify opportunities to unbundle, tier, or price Headway's existing feature set as new revenue lines, while balancing the provider experience.

  • Define Headway's pricing philosophy: Build a principled, defensible approach to how we set prices — transparent to providers, competitive in the market, and sustainable for the business.

  • Inform tiering with pricing data: Partner with other product teams to ensure pricing and tier design are grounded in experimental evidence, willingness-to-pay research, and elasticity data.

  • Build the experimentation infrastructure: Work with Engineering and Data to create systems that enable rapid, controlled pricing experiments across geographies and segments.

  • Navigate cross-functional complexity: Align Finance, Provider Growth, Payer, Ops, and Legal around pricing decisions that affect every part of the business.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of PM experience, with at least 2-3 years owning pricing, monetization, or marketplace economics.

  • You've personally owned pricing or packaging strategy and shipped changes that moved revenue.

  • You've designed and run pricing experiments at scale — you know the difference between a feature A/B test and a pricing experiment.

  • Strong quantitative fluency — you can partner with data scientists on experiment design and causal inference as a peer.

  • You thrive in ambiguity and can build structure where none exists — this is a new team.

  • Bonus: SaaS pricing & packaging experience (PLG, tiering, bundling).

  • Bonus: You've worked in a two-sided marketplace or platform where pricing affects both supply and demand.

  • Bonus: Healthcare or regulated industry experience.

That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over $63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What You'll Do

Roboflow is in the middle of one of the biggest narrative shifts in our history. We are moving from being known as a data labeling tool for developers to being known as the Vision AI platform that powers production deployments inside the world's largest companies. Half the Fortune 100 already uses us. The next phase is making sure they, and the buyers inside them, see us that way.

Own positioning end-to-end: Define how we talk about products and features. You will sharpen the messaging, build the proof, and make sure every external facing surface tells a coherent story.

Lead product launches: Architect launches that land. Pick the moments that matter, build the narrative arc, line up the customer references, brief the analysts, and equip the field. You know what a great launch looks like and you've run them before.

Build the buyer surfaces: Buyer facing landing pages, ROI frameworks, vertical specific narratives, customer outcomes, named reference stories. The website and content library should serve buyers as well as they serve developers.

Deliver content that sales actually uses: Decks, battle cards, objection handling, competitive intel, pricing positioning. Talk to AEs every week. Build the materials they will actually use in a live deal.

Productize customer proof: Turn customer wins into structured outcomes led case studies, video, webinars, conference talks, and peer referral motion. Operationalize the reference machine.

Drive vertical strategy: Industrial, logistics, aerospace and defense, automotive, energy, healthcare. Help decide where to lean in, then build the vertical-specific messaging, content, and field motion to win there.

Who You Are

You've owned positioning end-to-end. Not just executed someone else's narrative. You've sat in front of the whiteboard, talked to 30 customers, written the messaging house, gotten leadership aligned, and rolled it out across the company. You can show us examples.

You've led product launches that moved the needle. You can name specific launches, what your role was, what the inputs were, and what the result was. You sweat the inputs because you know the difference between a launch that lands and one that disappears.

B2B experience. You've marketed to B2B buyers with $150K+ ACVs and complex sales cycles. You understand how Heads of AI and C-suite buyers make decisions, and you've built materials for each.

Technical fluency. You should be comfortable in a technical conversation. Computer vision, ML infrastructure, or developer tools background is a strong plus.

Excellent writer. Crisp, plain, specific. You can write the deck, the landing page, the email, and the script for a sales call. You cut filler.

Sales partnership instinct. You like working with sales. You know how to embed with the field, attend deal reviews, learn what's actually winning, and bring it back into marketing.

High output, low ego. You will move fast across a lot of surfaces. You will get feedback from a lot of people. You build the work, hold the bar, and ship.

Who You'll Be Working With

You will work directly with our Marketing Lead, our sales team, our co-founders, product leadership, and customer success. Your work shows up in every deal in the pipeline.

Our team's backgrounds range from high school whiz kids, former founders of technology companies and fashion lines, world-class engineers, CMOs to CEOs, and have experience scaling businesses to millions in revenue. We want to work with exceptional people with a diverse background. At this stage, you'll have the ability to work cross-functionally with many members of the team and solve a wide array of problems.

Where You'll Work

We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco with a mindset of opening more offices as we grow. We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs, work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best. Learn more about how we work at Roboflow.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every 6 months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

$3500/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers.

$350/mo productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high speed internet at home or a co-working space.

Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family.

Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision.

Interview Process

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. You will be speaking directly with our team about what it's like to work and thrive here.

Introduction Phase:

[45m] Meet with hiring manager, Trevor Lynn, to assess for overall mindset and skill set

This first interview is a time to get to know more about the role, allow us to get to know you better, and ensure it's a good fit for both parties to continue moving forward in the process

Team Interview Phase:

[60m] Meet with a member of our marketing team

[60m] Meet with a member of our product or marketing team

[30m] Meet with hiring manager, Trevor Lynn

Use this time to review specifics about the job description and ask questions before the project phase begins.

Project Phase:

You'll build a project within a specified amount of time. Expect something that resembles real PMM work: a positioning exercise, a launch plan for a real or hypothetical Roboflow release, or a sales-enablement asset for a specific buyer.

We check references and conduct a background check.

Final Interview Stage:

[60m] Meet with Co-founder & CTO, Brad Dwyer or Joseph Nelson, Co-founder & CEO

Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can.

jobs.jobDescription:
About the Job:

The Enterprise Acquisition Account Executive will drive LaunchDarkly's growth by acquiring new enterprise customers through 100 percent net new logo generation. Owning a defined territory, you will develop and execute strategic account plans, generate new opportunities, and deliver tailored solutions that demonstrate LaunchDarkly's value. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on breaking into greenfield accounts and closing new business.

Responsibilities:

  • Territory Management: Develop and maintain comprehensive territory and account plans.
  • Pipeline Generation: Secure consistent new opportunities through targeted outreach and account research.
  • Revenue Growth: Achieve quarterly revenue and new logo acquisition targets.
  • Customer Engagement: Build strong relationships with champions and decision-makers, developing compelling business cases.
  • Collaboration: Work with SDRs, SEs, and other teams to ensure seamless execution and customer success.
  • Strategic Thinking & Execution:
    • Design and execute long-term strategies that drive business growth within a defined territory.
    • Identify and capitalize on market opportunities and align them with company objectives.
    • Adapt strategies as market dynamics evolve, ensuring continuous growth and a competitive edge.
  • Enterprise Sales Expertise:
    • Proven track record in enterprise sales, including lead generation, opportunity identification, negotiation, and closing high-value deals.
    • Deep understanding of the enterprise sales cycle and the ability to manage complex, multi-stage deals.
    • Skilled in selling to C-suite executives and senior decision-makers, developing customized solutions that address business needs.
  • Customer-Centric Problem Solving:
    • Assess customer pain points and design tailored solutions that create measurable value.
    • Build long-term relationships with key customers, acting as a trusted advisor to solve their business challenges.
    • Overcome obstacles and find innovative solutions to meet customer needs.
  • Independent Decision Making:
    • Work autonomously with minimal day-to-day supervision, making sound decisions based on analysis of data and situational factors.
    • Take ownership of the territory, managing customer acquisition with confidence and minimal instruction.
    • Prioritize tasks and make decisions quickly, ensuring alignment with broader business goals.
  • Analytical Skills & Data-Driven Insights:
    • Analyze market data, sales metrics, and customer insights to inform strategies and decision-making.
    • Evaluate diverse factors to identify trends, resolve complex issues, and optimize sales efforts.
    • Use CRM and sales tools to track and analyze performance.
  • Negotiation & Deal Structuring:
    • Negotiate large-scale, complex contracts, balancing customer needs with company goals.
    • Create mutually beneficial agreements that result in long-term business relationships.
    • Handle objections, overcome resistance, and close deals in a competitive market.
  • Communication & Influence:
    • Exhibit strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and persuade key stakeholders.
    • Present solutions and negotiate with C-suite executives, ensuring clear understanding and alignment.
    • Communicate complex ideas concisely and compellingly to diverse audiences.
  • Collaboration & Team Leadership:
    • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product, and customer success, to align efforts and drive growth.
    • Demonstrate leadership in managing internal resources, ensuring alignment with company goals.
    • Motivate and influence team members across departments to achieve common objectives.
  • Results-Driven Focus:
    • Maintain a strong focus on achieving measurable sales outcomes and consistently meeting or exceeding targets.
    • Demonstrate motivation by performance metrics and commitment to continuous improvement.
    • Take ownership for results, holding oneself accountable for achieving objectives.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of sales experience, with a focus on net-new logo acquisition.
  • Proven success in selling technical solutions to CIO/CTO-level personas in competitive or unbudgeted environments.
  • Strong track record of exceeding quotas and managing complex sales cycles.
  • Understanding of IT infrastructure and organizational structures.
  • Expertise in account planning, stakeholder mapping, and value articulation.
  • Proficiency in sales methodologies like discovery frameworks and cost justifications.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $269,400 - $370,480**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $242,500 - $333,410**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $229,000 - $314,930**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com.

Do you need a disability accommodation?

Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @LaunchDarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit Careers | LaunchDarkly directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.

Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to careers@launchdarkly.com.

jobs.jobDescription:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

As Counsel, Corporate & Risk, you will be a key strategic partner to Headway’s Procurement, Finance, Customer Experience, and Communications teams during a pivotal growth phase for the company. In this role, you will gain broad in-house exposure across Headway’s third-party contracting, disputes and escalated requests, corporate insurance, and other corporate and risk matters (reporting to the Associate General Counsel, Commercial and Corporate). This is a unique opportunity to join a mission-driven healthcare technology company; work alongside world-class colleagues; and in an environment where Legal is viewed as a true strategic partner — and where our investment in AI will drive your growth in operating at ‘top-of-license.’

You will own:

  • Third-party and vendor contracting — building out and leading our agentic first-pass contract review, while serving as DRI on escalations and exceptions that reflect our goals and priorities.

  • A key subset of disputes and escalated requests — e.g., patient cost disputes, escalated provider matters, administrative/regulatory inquiries, and escalated document and records requests — partnering closely with Customer Experience and Communications to resolve effectively.

  • Headway’s annual corporate insurance cycle and ongoing insurance administration.

  • Other corporate and risk matters that arise within a fast-growing start-up environment.

You’d be a great fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of legal experience, including at least 2 years in-house

  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth start-up environment (healthcare preferred)

  • Hands-on ownership of complex processes like commercial contracting at scale, and the judgment to balance risk and trade-offs with the right mix of fidelity and velocity.

  • Strong emotional intelligence — you will be the face of Legal to cross-functional partners on matters that may be escalated, time-sensitive, or both. You are able to build relationships and consensus with colleagues amid competing views and priorities

  • Genuine interest in working with AI tooling, and in improving or reinventing the systems you work in (versus simply operating within them)

  • Ability to translate complex topics into clear and actionable advice for non-legal stakeholders

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active bar membership in good standing (ability to register as NY in-house counsel required)

Comprehensive benefits:

Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave.

We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview.

Headway participates in E-Verify. To learn more, click here.

A notice to Headway applicants: To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that Headway only accepts applications through our official careers page at https://headway.co/careers. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com email address. If you are contacted by someone claiming to be from Headway via an unofficial channel, please do not share any information and report it as spam.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."

TeamSnap is seeking an Account Manager to own strategic relationships with our largest Sports Organization customers, driving retention, product adoption, and growth. This is a results-driven role built for someone who thrives on managing complex, high-value accounts through a consultative approach — not a high-volume, transactional book of business. Ideal candidates bring strong B2B relationship management skills, a consultative sales approach, and a collaborative mindset that makes the whole team better.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage a portfolio of our largest accounts, establishing strong relationships and hitting retention goals

  • Run demos of TeamSnap platforms to show the value of new products or add-ons

  • Use account and usage data to drive proactive outreach — building account plans, spotting risk or expansion signals before customers raise them, and communicating results

  • Drive a value-based sales process, uncovering customer needs through deep discovery and customized demonstrations of the capabilities that solve them

  • Manage your upsell pipeline to hit renewal and expansion targets across your portfolio

  • Follow up on marketing-driven campaigns, turning outreach into your portfolio into real engagement — identifying challenges, educating customers, and creating growth opportunities

  • Serve as the "Voice of the Customer" internally, escalating product feedback to ensure proper product prioritization

Important Qualities:

  • Motivated — you get excited about exceeding retention and growth goals

  • Strong business acumen — you understand our customers' goals and operations and how TeamSnap adds value

  • A great listener — you can absorb a lot of customer feedback, and know how to turn it into action

  • Resourceful — you take initiative but also ask for guidance when needed

  • Customer focused — you have compassion and care for the customer experience

  • Collaborative — you believe in "we" before "I" and love to celebrate wins together

What Will Set You Up For Success:

  • 1-3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Relationship Management, or Account Management, preferably in a SaaS environment

  • A proven track record of hitting retention and expansion targets

  • Experience managing complex, high-value accounts where relationship depth matters more than volume

  • Ability to travel occasionally, including our annual company meeting, periodic sales team meetings, potential trade shows, and client visits

  • Sports industry experience (preferred)

Compensation

Additional Information

Do you have cold feet? If you think you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

Compensation

We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The starting point for this role is an OTE of $73,000, inclusive of base and commissions. Comp is updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

Location

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

Opportunities to Grow

At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it.

Total Rewards

• We're proud to be remote-first. We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool

• Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary)

• 100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family

• 401K to help you invest for the future

• $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

• Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events

• Generous home office allowance to set you up for success

• TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter

• A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more!

• TeamSnap Total Rewards

Working at TeamSnap

At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit, you're a culture add. Check out our Culture Playbook and learn how we succeed at being remote-first, what makes our company so unique, and how we're inspired by our people, our customers, and our values.

Inclusion and Diversity

Creativity and innovation can't thrive when we're cookie-cutter images of each other. We’re quickly growing more diverse, but there's always room for improvement. We are committed to inclusion and diversity at TeamSnap, and we hold ourselves accountable for building an environment where everyone feels valued. If you need any disability-related adaptation during the recruitment process, just let us know! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

jobs.jobDescription:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the Role

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of a new, fast-growing, and highly visible team at Angi.

The Senior Manager of Large Pro Strategy will work directly with the Senior Director of Partner Strategy and the Large Pro team to drive growth and success for our largest pro partners by diving into the data to find opportunities for improvement, putting together business cases, and driving change via large cross-functional projects. You will devise strategy, build frameworks, structure solutions, manage projects, and drive & measure results in the most critical areas of the business.

In this role, you will own and/or support impactful strategic priorities; work with research, analytics, operations and product teams to identify test ideas and execute. You will be expected to know our Large Pro service providers and the operational teams that support them inside and out, serving as a critical thought partner to the Sr Director of Partner Strategy, SVP of Large Pro, pro product, and beyond.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Independently own key strategic initiatives (or critical work streams within it) from initial concept through execution and success measurement.

  • Alongside an all-star team of peers and stakeholders, steer quantitative and qualitative research efforts into financial and operational drivers of Pro success and inform decision-making.

  • Build clear and concise presentations that summarize your findings and lead to clear recommendations.

  • Provide thought partnership to the Partner Strategy team and cross-functional partners.

  • Program manage large strategic changes that involve many teams and span multiple months, building cross-functional buy-in and collaboration, and providing updates and impact to senior leadership.

  • Proactively leverage GenAI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) to rapidly synthesize complex partner performance data and cross-functional insights, streamlining the creation of strategic proposals and materials, thereby maximizing time for high-value consultative engagement and driving partner growth.

  • Work directly with stakeholders at the highest-value customers to help solve problems that unlock business growth for Angi; develop strategies based on those learnings to apply across the Large Pro network

About you

  • Self-starter; owner; someone who can manage and execute projects to completion

  • First class communication skills

  • Maintain a careful balance between attention to detail and swift execution

  • Data-driven

  • Has a strong bias for action

  • Thrive with ambiguity

  • Team player; collaborates and influences effectively with cross-functional team members across the organization

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher

  • 3-5 years of professional experience in consulting, finance, strategy, business development or operations experience

  • Strong analytical and execution background - demonstrated experience gathering data from various sources and driving strategic insight and decision-making

  • Management consulting experience at a top firm strongly preferred

  • Startup experience is a plus

  • A strong interest in Angi, home services, marketplaces and product-driven organizations

Compensation & Benefits

  • The salary band for this position ranges from $110,000 - $160,000 commensurate with experience and performance. Compensation may vary based on factors such as cost of living.

  • This position will be eligible for a competitive year end performance bonus & equity package.

  • Full medical, dental, vision package to fit your needs

  • Flexible vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it

  • Pet discount plans & retirement plan with company match (401K)

  • The rare opportunity to work with sharp, motivated teammates solving some of the most unique, complex challenges

We value diversity

We know that the best ideas come from teams where diverse points of view uncover new solutions to hard problems. We welcome and value individuals who bring diverse life experiences, educational backgrounds, cultures, and work experiences.

Our hiring process may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

#LI-Remote

jobs.jobDescription:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Senior Director, Data and Product Management

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for ChargePoint's fleet software platforms — including ViriCiti (telematics and fleet management) and new platforms being developed for truck fleets and autonomous vehicle operators.
  • Drive the evolution of existing platforms: identify gaps in the current customer experience, prioritize improvements, and ensure the platform continues to meet the needs of today's fleet operators while scaling for future growth.
  • Define and build net-new software products for emerging fleet segments, including purpose-built solutions for commercial truck charging management and autonomous vehicle fleet operations.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, and business priorities into clear product requirements, user stories, and success metrics — working closely with engineering and design to ship high-quality software.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, customer success, and data science to align on market opportunities, support go-to-market execution, and drive adoption of fleet software solutions.
  • Engage directly with fleet customers and prospects to deeply understand their workflows, pain points, and evolving software needs — bringing the voice of the customer into every product decision.
  • Communicate product vision, progress, and trade-offs clearly to a wide array of stakeholders, from engineering teams to executive leadership.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

ChargePoint is seeking a Staff Product Manager, Fleet Software to own the software product strategy and roadmap for our fleet vertical. Reporting to the Senior Director, Product, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of ChargePoint's fleet software platforms in North America and Europe — from maintaining and evolving our existing solutions such as ViriCiti to defining and building new platforms for emerging segments including truck and autonomous vehicle fleets. This is an individual contributor role in which you will operate as a hands-on product leader, partnering closely with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams to ship software that fleet operators love.

Requirements

  • 12 years of product management experience, with a strong focus on software products — ideally in fleet management, telematics, mobility, energy management, or adjacent SaaS platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and evolve existing software platforms while simultaneously defining new products from the ground up.
  • Experience working with fleet operators, commercial vehicle customers, or logistics companies preferred
  • Strong technical fluency — able to engage meaningfully with engineering teams on software architecture, APIs, and data pipelines without needing to write code.
  • Customer-obsessed and data-driven, with experience translating qualitative customer insight and quantitative data into prioritized product decisions.
  • Intellectually curious, analytical, creative, collaborative, and a strategic thinker who can work effectively as an individual contributor in a matrixed organization.
  • Strong communication skills — able to translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, structured narratives for diverse stakeholders.
  • Based in North America

Location

North America - Remote

About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

We’re looking for a driven and results-oriented Account Executive to accelerate growth by identifying, engaging, and securing new customers. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in expanding our footprint across key industries by developing strategic relationships and turning prospects into long-term clients. You thrive in building pipeline from the ground up, navigating complex sales cycles, and closing high-impact deals.

This is a role for someone who takes the initiative, enjoys opening new doors, and knows how to create value where others see barriers. You’ll be supported by a cross-functional team, but you lead the charge, bringing our solutions to new markets and decision-makers.

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact

As Manager, Customer Recovery, you own the retention engine and critical recovery motions that turn high-risk accounts into long-term brand advocates. You lead a specialized team of Customer Recovery Coaches who sit at the vital intersection of customer retention, risk mitigation, and product success. You will scale our Intelligent Recovery Motion and oversee the Fire-Team concept, a cross-functional, executive-level intervention designed to deliver decisive issue resolution during critical retention moments. As a leader, you understand that technology should handle administrative drag so your team can focus on customer connection and meaningful interactions. Your job is to turn reactive support into proactive rescue operations, using data and systemic feedback loops to ensure Cloudbeds remains central to our customers' business success. This is a player-coach role, leading a high-performing team of Customer Recovery Coaches while overseeing critical recovery operations across mid-market and SMB accounts.

Our Customer Recovery Team

Our Customer Recovery Team is dedicated to rescuing at-risk accounts and transforming customer frustration into long-term loyalty. Serving as trusted internal consultants and single points of contact for customers at critical moments in the Customer Journey, Recovery Coaches mobilize cross-functional response teams to swiftly eliminate customer friction. This is a team of problem-solvers - regardless of what led the customer to the Recovery team, they always focus on a few key goals: prevent churn, take unhappy customers and get them back on track, and identify key customer experience friction points to drive continuous improvement across the organization.

What You Bring to the Team

• Lead, coach, and develop a specialized team of Customer Recovery Coaches, running regular 1:1s, risk portfolio reviews, and clear performance expectations, while hiring, onboarding, and continuously upskilling new Recovery Coaches
• Set the operating rhythm for the Customer Recovery motion: risk queue triage, Fire-Team mobilizations, post-sales friction resolution, executive escalation tracking, and weekly retention forecasts
• Oversee and optimize the Fire-Team motion as an executive escalation owner, helping coaches mobilize cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales to restore trust
• Ensure the team effectively triages high-impact queues of at-risk customers, driving proactive rescue and structured save motions, and guide the team in executing Rapid Wins that prioritize immediate operational stabilization
• Own and execute the "Recovery Becomes Prevention" feedback loop, treating cancellation requests and severe risk as systemic failures and transforming root-cause insights into actionable product and process improvements
• Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Onboarding, and Customer Support leadership to eliminate recurring operational blockers and friction points that deplete customers and internal teams
• Champion "Standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful" by working with CS Ops to implement AI-driven tooling, automated risk detection, and clean CRM reporting in Salesforce

What Sets You Up for Success

• 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Retention, CS Ops, or Post-Sales Operations in B2B SaaS
• At least 2 years of direct people management or proven lead experience managing high-stakes customer retention workflows
• Significant direct management experience in hotel or resort operations (front office, revenue, or property management), with a deep understanding of the real business impact when hotel technology fails
• Exceptional emotional intelligence and proven capability in executive-level de-escalation, trust building, and high-impact problem solving
• Technical aptitude to leverage AI tooling and automation to unlock team capacity, with high attention to detail and strict standards for CRM hygiene, activity logging, and process documentation
• Proven ability to drive alignment and mobilize internal teams across Product, Support, and Sales without relying solely on direct authority

Bonus Skills to Stand Out

• Deep experience managing customer recovery or retention motions across SMB, mid-market, enterprise, or multi-property hospitality clients (management companies, branded clusters, or franchise models)
• Fluency in Spanish and English
• Familiarity with Salesforce, Zendesk, or advanced CS risk-analytics tooling

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us
Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care, a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

About the Role

Our Negotiations Escalations Specialists play a key role in the success of our clients becoming free of debt. Working on behalf of clients, you will coordinate efforts to help negotiate delinquent accounts placed with Law Firms for the best possible savings.

This role requires the judgment to interpret legal correspondence — summonses, complaints, and settlement demands — and translate it into an informed negotiation strategy, all while operating within a strict regulatory and compliance framework. The ideal candidate is a sharp communicator and relationship-builder who is comfortable working under legal deadlines and pressure, and who takes real satisfaction in helping clients move toward financial freedom.

What You’ll Do

  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with attorneys and paralegals at Law Firms to effectively negotiate delinquent accounts on behalf of clients to cease further legal action.
  • Manage a portfolio of accounts simultaneously — including escalated portfolios with active lawsuits or imminent legal action
  • Utilize various tools and resources to consolidate common debts from multiple clients, enhancing negotiation leverage with agencies.
  • Secure favorable terms including reduced balances, extended payment timelines, or lump-sum discounts.
  • Demonstrate excellent time management and multitasking skills to efficiently manage account queues.
  • Handle approximately 25-35 outbound/inbound calls daily (minimum of 4 hours a day of on the phone time)
  • Review legal documents (such as summons, complaints, and settlement demands) to determine legal status and to confirm settlement status.
  • Consistently exhibit a genuine passion for helping others, with a strong focus on meeting clients' needs.
  • Participate in additional duties and special projects as required.
  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly settlement and compliance goals.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business Administration, Finance, Banking, Actuarial Science) or relevant work experience is preferred.
  • Exceptional communication skills, including listening, verbal, and written abilities.
  • Proven success working in a metrics-driven, KPI focused environment is preferred.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong commitment to teamwork, collaboration, and fostering an inclusive environment.
  • A deep passion for assisting others, with a client-focused approach.
  • Proficiency in technology; experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems is a plus.

The base salary range represents the anticipated salary range for this position. The actual base salary offered within the range will depend on numerous factors including the individual’s skills, experience, performance, and the location where work is performed. In addition to base salary, this position qualifies for commission. Negotiation Specialists earn a monthly commission based on the amount of debt negotiated subject to the terms outlined in the company's commission plan. While you make a difference for others, we’ll work to make a difference for you, providing an uplifting, collaborative work environment and benefits that reflect your value to us. For eligible full-time employees, we offer:

jobs.jobDescription:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

Reports to: Vice President, Partnerships

Level: Director (we are open to hiring at Senior Director level for more experienced candidates)

Role overview

GiveDirectly intends to transfer $10B by 2035 while building a resilient, durable cash-first movement in the aid sector.

To reach this milestone, we have brought all fundraising efforts under one leadership, to enable better coordination and optimisation of fundraising streams and operations over time. This unified approach is building a high-performance fundraising team that identifies and secures high-quality leads, while standardizing revenue operations and knowledge-sharing across all verticals, enabling a better donor experience and securing long-term funding to achieve our goals of eliminating extreme poverty and responding better in crisis.

The Director/Senior Director, Revenue Operations will own the operating backbone of the Fundraising function: the data, systems, and processes that let Partnerships, Philanthropy, Individual Giving, and Special Projects run at scale. As we grow our Emergency Cash and US work alongside our work on ending extreme poverty, the candidate will also help ensure fundraising strategies are complementary rather than competing. This is a BizOps-first role. You will build the pipeline infrastructure, KPI architecture, and operating rhythms that make Fundraising's growth predictable and measurable, and you will represent Fundraising to Finance, Compliance, Grants Management, and the People team.

Alongside this, the role carries a chief-of-staff dimension: partnering with the Vice President of Partnership on strategic priorities, high-stakes internal and external communications, and organizational change management, so the VP's time is focused on the highest-impact work.

Depending on the skills and interests of the person we hire, this role may grow to manage a team of 3-5, covering some combination of: fundraising tech and data (e.g. Salesforce), donor experience, and knowledge management. Reflecting our "Team Next" value and commitment to organizational excellence, this person will drive cross-functional collaboration to ensure fundraising operations scale seamlessly alongside our global growth.

Key responsibilities

Own Fundraising's revenue operations: data, systems, and process (primary focus)

  • Build and own the strategic data and systems architecture for Fundraising: pipeline tracking, annual and in-year forecasting, and reporting infrastructure (e.g. Salesforce) that gives every vertical a single, trustworthy source of truth.
  • Define, standardize, and own tracking of fit-for-purpose Fundraising KPIs, aligned to Board reporting needs and the team's long-term strategic direction.
  • Partner with counterparts on Fundraising Data and Tech to prioritize, execute, and approve projects that serve both functions.
  • Design and institutionalize the operating rhythms of the Fundraising function: pipeline reviews, QBRs, reporting cadences, and the processes that turn strategy into consistent execution.
  • Develop revenue systems and processes alongside the Finance, Fundraising and Donor Experience teams that support scalable growth, protect donor journeys, and ensure capital moves securely and efficiently through the organization.
  • Own revenue reconciliation and recognition, pledge and receivable tracking, restricted-fund coding, monthly/annual close handoff, or audit support.
  • Own workforce and capacity planning for Fundraising in partnership with the VP: role scoping, hiring prioritization, and structural improvements as the team scales.

Build and lead a team as the function matures

  • As the role grows, manage a team of 3-5 covering fundraising tech and data (e.g. Salesforce), donor experience, and knowledge management, setting priorities, coaching, and ensuring quality across each area.
  • Set clear ownership and operating cadences across the team so each workstream (tech and data, donor experience, knowledge management) has a defined remit and reduces duplicated effort across Fundraising verticals.

Act as the go-to liaison between Fundraising and other functions

  • Maintain a comprehensive view of Fundraising needs across all verticals and sub-teams, and act as the single point of contact for Grants Management, Finance, and Compliance on run-rate donor management processes.
  • Represent Fundraising's operational needs to the People team, Legal, and other functions as cross-functional systems and initiatives are designed and launched.

Partner with the VP on strategy and organizational effectiveness (chief-of-staff functions)

  • Collaborate with the Vice President to refine the unit's strategy, manage organizational change, and lead internal communications.
  • Streamline decision-making, manage priorities, and provide strategic counsel to maximize the VP's focus and effectiveness on high-impact work.
  • Prepare briefing materials and executive-level communications for senior leadership and Board audiences as needed.

Lead on cross-fundraising initiatives and priorities

  • Address broader organizational priorities as needed, including high-level donor stewardship coordination, cross-functional system launches, flexible workforce planning, or market expansion initiatives.

This role would suit somebody who is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, who is energized by building systems and structure out of ambiguity, and who enjoys pulling together disparate workstreams into a cohesive, impactful strategy. It's a strong fit for someone with a business operations, revenue operations, or chief-of-staff background who wants a role weighted toward building and owning systems (and, over time, building a team) rather than one focused primarily on executive support.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years of experience in revenue operations, business operations, or a chief-of-staff role, ideally within a fundraising, sales, or partnerships organization.

jobs.jobDescription:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Business Applications Team

The Business Applications org builds and operates the internal systems that keep Thumbtack running at scale: Salesforce-centered workflows, admin tooling, and the integrations that connect teams across the company. We're now expanding that foundation into a broader internal platform for AI-enabled work — shared APIs, reusable integration patterns, and safe, auditable capabilities for business-critical actions. We work directly with the business teams who depend on these systems, turning complex operational needs into software that's easier to run, extend, and automate responsibly.

The challenge

Agents can already take action inside Thumbtack's internal systems. The harder problem is making that trustworthy: giving business teams a way to configure what agents are allowed to do, review and correct their work, and see clearly what happened and why. Without that, automation stays stuck in pilots. This engineer owns the product surface that turns agent capability into something teams will actually rely on for business-critical work — and the services behind it.

What you’ll do

  • Design and build the interfaces business teams use to configure agents, review their work, approve or correct actions, and understand what happened and why.

  • Build observability and evaluation tooling that makes agent behavior legible — where it succeeded, where it failed, and whether a change made things better.

  • Work across the stack, from React and TypeScript through service code and data models, owning features end to end through build, test, launch, and iteration.

  • Partner directly with the business teams who use what you build; translate ambiguous operational problems into working software.

  • Own the full lifecycle of your work, including monitoring and post-launch improvement.

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Strong frontend skills with React and TypeScript, including complex application state and data-dense interfaces.

  • Solid backend engineering ability. We use Go, PHP, and Python, and we expect strong engineers to pick up a new language.

  • Working knowledge of relational and non-relational data stores (Postgres, DynamoDB, or similar).

  • Real product judgment: you can look at a workflow, decide what to build, and say what to cut.

  • Interest in the problems that come with non-deterministic systems — uncertainty, partial failure, and designing for human correction rather than assuming a correct answer every time.

  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, close your own knowledge gaps, and deliver in an evolving environment.

Expected salary ranges

  • For candidates living in San Francisco / Bay Area, San Jose, New York City, or Seattle metros, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for the role is currently $177,700.00 - $229,900.00.

  • For candidates living in all other US locations, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for the role is currently $151,300.00 - $195,800.00.

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

About the Role:

We are seeking a committed Commercial Sales Executive with a successful background in sales and account management, ideally within open source or similar enterprise software environments. In this role, you will be a key driver of our growth strategy, directly impacting the stability and expansion of our recurring revenue. This position is ideal for a sales professional who has experience in landing new clients, retaining existing customers, and driving account expansion for early-stage enterprise products in a dynamic, entrepreneurial setting.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute sales strategies to target commercial customers, focusing on building and maintaining a robust pipeline that drives long-term growth.

  • Own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and initial outreach to contract negotiations and closing deals, while consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including product, marketing, and customer success, to ensure a seamless sales experience and alignment on customer needs.

  • Identify customer pain points and align our solutions to address these, delivering customized product demos and presentations tailored to their specific business needs.

  • Build and nurture relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers within target accounts, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor and ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.

  • Lead account planning efforts by researching potential customers, understanding industry trends, and developing strategies to win new business and grow existing accounts.

  • Monitor and manage sales activities and results, accurately forecasting opportunities and keeping detailed records of interactions and progress in CRM systems.

  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and market changes to position our product effectively and maintain a competitive edge.

  • Contribute to business growth initiatives, providing feedback to product and marketing teams to influence product development and go-to-market strategies.

  • Represent Kong with professionalism, acting as a brand ambassador at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in sales (<1k employees) a SaaS, cloud, or enterprise software environment.

  • 2+ years closing deals independently, preferably in Commercial & Mid-Market.

  • Demonstrated success in selling to small to medium enterprises, particularly to senior-level executives and across multiple departments.

  • Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and present compelling solutions that drive business outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of managing high-stakes conversations and building lasting relationships with stakeholders.

  • A results-driven mindset, with a passion for meeting and exceeding sales goals and revenue targets.

  • Experience working with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and leveraging data to forecast accurately and track sales metrics.

  • Knowledge of open-source software, APIs, or infrastructure software is highly advantageous.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, taking ownership of your sales territory and adapting to changing market dynamics.

  • Analytical and strategic thinking, with a knack for identifying business growth opportunities and devising plans to capitalize on them.

    #LI-JW1

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.jobDescription:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary
ExtraHop’s Solutions Architecture team is very different from many other post-sales services practices—we focus on outcomes and customer success rather than racking up billable hours. As a member of our Solutions Architecture team, you’ll play a critical role in the success of our customers, products and position in the marketplace. Our Architects tackle the most difficult business and technology problems across a vast array of industries and technologies. As a Solutions Architect at ExtraHop, you will never be bored again.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced GUI development
  • Advanced Trigger Script development
  • Intermediate external REST API script development
  • Intermediate understanding of networking
  • Intermediate understanding of application design
  • Analyze customer network topologies and application stacks; develop strategies to acquire high-value data from the wire.
  • Profile industry-specific applications across a broad range of verticals; create technical assets and written collateral to support product improvement and marketing efforts.
  • Conduct root cause analysis of high-profile technology problems and advise customers on their resolution.
  • Develop custom tools using Python and JavaScript-based APIs to extend the functionality of the ExtraHop platform.
  • Develop customized data analysis to monitor changing technical and business conditions in real-time.
  • Create rich data visualizations to aid tactical investigations and realize strategic objectives.
  • Create automated tools to streamline repeatable processes and maximize time spent building intelligent solutions.
  • Conduct hands-on learning sessions with key customer personnel.

Required Qualifications

  • 6-8 years of relevant experience
  • BS degree or equivalent
  • Experience in customer-facing positions; excellent interpersonal skills
  • Understanding of core networking principles (layers 2 through 4 of the OSI model) and application protocols (HTTP, SQL, CIFS/NFS, HL7, Memcache, DNS)
  • Familiarity with principles of internet worked applications and related technologies (HTTP, databases, caching, distributed systems, etc)
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python and JavaScript
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Independence, motivation, and desire for practice ownership

Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $163,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective ay 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.
